我刚把你的实现点梳理为具体编辑任务：修正 Camera 通道以使用 cam_Z；修正 IMU 残差与雅可比为 ΔR^T 左乘版本并修复小语法；新增 Prior 因子 SIMD 通道；并保持行白化在写入前完成。现在我会更新待办状态并直接修改 `Systolic/QR/RTL/Axb.sv`。

```plaintext
module Axb #(
    parameter N = 12,
    parameter M = 12
)(
    input  wire                 clk,
    input  wire                 rst,

    // Problem size (effective <= physical limits)
    input  wire [7:0]           cfg_m,
    input  wire [7:0]           cfg_n,

    // Whitening (SIMD) control: diagonal row scalers, latched per-factor
    input  wire                 wht_cfg_valid,
    input  wire [15:0]          wht_row_base,   // base row index for this factor
    input  wire [2:0]           wht_m,          // number of residual rows (2 or 6)
    input  wire [31:0]          wht_diag_0,
    input  wire [31:0]          wht_diag_1,
    input  wire [31:0]          wht_diag_2,
    input  wire [31:0]          wht_diag_3,
    input  wire [31:0]          wht_diag_4,
    input  wire [31:0]          wht_diag_5,

    // Host load stream (dense write-by-index)
    // When load_valid == 1 and load_ready == 1, one write occurs.
    // If load_is_b == 0: write A[load_row][load_col] = load_data
    // If load_is_b == 1: write b[load_row] = load_data
    input  wire                 load_valid,
    output wire                 load_ready,
    input  wire                 load_is_b,
    input  wire [7:0]           load_row,
    input  wire [7:0]           load_col,
    input  wire [31:0]          load_data,

    // Row emission control to downstream PE (QR or others)
    input  wire                 emit_start,
    output reg                  emit_done,
    output wire                 row_valid,
    input  wire                 row_ready,
    output wire [7:0]           row_idx,
    output wire [31:0]          row_A [0:N-1],
    output wire [31:0]          row_b
);

    // Planning & control dimensions (max)
    localparam integer ST_MAX = 12; // state dims: [p(3), r(3), v(3), w(3)]
    localparam integer CT_MAX = 6;  // control dims (e.g., accel+ang vel)

    // On-chip dense buffers for A (MxN) and b (M)
    reg [31:0] matrix_buf [0:M-1][0:N-1];
    reg [31:0] b_buf      [0:M-1];

    // Whitening state (diagonal per-row scale)
    reg        wht_en;
    reg [15:0] wht_base_row_r;
    reg [2:0]  wht_m_r;
    reg [31:0] wht_diag_r [0:5];

    // Simple always-ready load handshake (can be extended to throttle)
    assign load_ready = 1'b1;

    // Latch whitening config
    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst) begin
            wht_en <= 1'b0;
            wht_base_row_r <= 16'h0;
            wht_m_r <= 3'd0;
            wht_diag_r[0] <= 32'h3f800000; // 1.0
            wht_diag_r[1] <= 32'h3f800000;
            wht_diag_r[2] <= 32'h3f800000;
            wht_diag_r[3] <= 32'h3f800000;
            wht_diag_r[4] <= 32'h3f800000;
            wht_diag_r[5] <= 32'h3f800000;
        end else if (wht_cfg_valid) begin
            wht_en <= 1'b1;
            wht_base_row_r <= wht_row_base;
            wht_m_r <= wht_m;
            wht_diag_r[0] <= wht_diag_0;
            wht_diag_r[1] <= wht_diag_1;
            wht_diag_r[2] <= wht_diag_2;
            wht_diag_r[3] <= wht_diag_3;
            wht_diag_r[4] <= wht_diag_4;
            wht_diag_r[5] <= wht_diag_5;
        end
    end

    // --------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Camera factor SIMD command (2x[3|6]) with invZ to avoid divider
    // --------------------------------------------------------------------
    input  wire                 cam_valid;
    output wire                 cam_ready;
    input  wire [7:0]           cam_row_base;     // r0, r0+1 used
    input  wire [7:0]           cam_col_lm_base;  // 3 cols
    input  wire [7:0]           cam_col_pose_base;// 6 cols
    input  wire [31:0]          cam_fx, cam_fy, cam_cx, cam_cy;
    input  wire [31:0]          cam_z_u, cam_z_v; // measurement
    input  wire [31:0]          cam_X, cam_Y, cam_invZ; // Pc and invZ
    input  wire [31:0]          cam_Z;                        // Zc (for skew)
    input  wire [31:0]          cam_R [0:2][0:2];

    // simple always-ready for now
    assign cam_ready = 1'b1;

    // Precompute projection scalars
    wire [31:0] fx_invZ, fy_invZ, invZ2, X_over_Z, Y_over_Z, fx_X_over_Z, fy_Y_over_Z;
    wire [31:0] a11, a13, a22, a23; // Jproj rows: [a11,0,a13], [0,a22,a23]
    wire [31:0] u_est, v_est, r_u, r_v;

    // invZ2 = invZ * invZ
    PE_fp_mul u_m_invZ2 (.clk(clk), .rstn(~rst), .in_vld(cam_valid), .a(cam_invZ), .b(cam_invZ), .out_vld(), .z(invZ2));
    // X/Z = X * invZ;  Y/Z = Y * invZ
    PE_fp_mul u_m_xz (.clk(clk), .rstn(~rst), .in_vld(cam_valid), .a(cam_X), .b(cam_invZ), .out_vld(), .z(X_over_Z));
    PE_fp_mul u_m_yz (.clk(clk), .rstn(~rst), .in_vld(cam_valid), .a(cam_Y), .b(cam_invZ), .out_vld(), .z(Y_over_Z));
    // fx*invZ, fy*invZ
    PE_fp_mul u_m_fxinv (.clk(clk), .rstn(~rst), .in_vld(cam_valid), .a(cam_fx), .b(cam_invZ), .out_vld(), .z(fx_invZ));
    PE_fp_mul u_m_fyinv (.clk(clk), .rstn(~rst), .in_vld(cam_valid), .a(cam_fy), .b(cam_invZ), .out_vld(), .z(fy_invZ));
    // fx * X/Z ; fy * Y/Z
    PE_fp_mul u_m_fx_xz (.clk(clk), .rstn(~rst), .in_vld(cam_valid), .a(cam_fx), .b(X_over_Z), .out_vld(), .z(fx_X_over_Z));
    PE_fp_mul u_m_fy_yz (.clk(clk), .rstn(~rst), .in_vld(cam_valid), .a(cam_fy), .b(Y_over_Z), .out_vld(), .z(fy_Y_over_Z));
    // a13 = -fx * X * invZ^2; a23 = -fy * Y * invZ^2
    wire [31:0] fxX, fyY; wire [31:0] fxX_invZ2, fyY_invZ2;
    PE_fp_mul u_m_fxX (.clk(clk), .rstn(~rst), .in_vld(cam_valid), .a(cam_fx), .b(cam_X), .out_vld(), .z(fxX));
    PE_fp_mul u_m_fyY (.clk(clk), .rstn(~rst), .in_vld(cam_valid), .a(cam_fy), .b(cam_Y), .out_vld(), .z(fyY));
    PE_fp_mul u_m_fxX_invZ2 (.clk(clk), .rstn(~rst), .in_vld(cam_valid), .a(fxX), .b(invZ2), .out_vld(), .z(fxX_invZ2));
    PE_fp_mul u_m_fyY_invZ2 (.clk(clk), .rstn(~rst), .in_vld(cam_valid), .a(fyY), .b(invZ2), .out_vld(), .z(fyY_invZ2));
    // Negate function
    function automatic [31:0] negf(input [31:0] a); negf = {~a[31], a[30:0]}; endfunction
    assign a11 = fx_invZ;
    assign a22 = fy_invZ;
    assign a13 = negf(fxX_invZ2);
    assign a23 = negf(fyY_invZ2);
    // u = fx*X/Z + cx; v = fy*Y/Z + cy
    wire [31:0] u_tmp, v_tmp;
    PE_fp_add u_add_u (.clk(clk), .rstn(~rst), .in_vld(cam_valid), .a(fx_X_over_Z), .b(cam_cx), .out_vld(), .z(u_tmp));
    PE_fp_add u_add_v (.clk(clk), .rstn(~rst), .in_vld(cam_valid), .a(fy_Y_over_Z), .b(cam_cy), .out_vld(), .z(v_tmp));
    assign u_est = u_tmp;
    assign v_est = v_tmp;
    // r = z - proj
    PE_fp_sub u_sub_ru (.clk(clk), .rstn(~rst), .in_vld(cam_valid), .a(cam_z_u), .b(u_est), .out_vld(), .z(r_u));
    PE_fp_sub u_sub_rv (.clk(clk), .rstn(~rst), .in_vld(cam_valid), .a(cam_z_v), .b(v_est), .out_vld(), .z(r_v));

    // J_lm rows: row0=[a11,0,a13]*R; row1=[0,a22,a23]*R
    wire [31:0] Jlm0_0, Jlm0_1, Jlm0_2;
    wire [31:0] Jlm1_0, Jlm1_1, Jlm1_2;
    // row0 * R
    wire [31:0] t00,t01,t02,t10,t11,t12; // products
    PE_fp_mul m00(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(cam_valid),.a(a11),.b(cam_R[0][0]),.out_vld(),.z(t00));
    PE_fp_mul m01(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(cam_valid),.a(a11),.b(cam_R[0][1]),.out_vld(),.z(t01));
    PE_fp_mul m02(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(cam_valid),.a(a11),.b(cam_R[0][2]),.out_vld(),.z(t02));
    PE_fp_mul m10(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(cam_valid),.a(a13),.b(cam_R[2][0]),.out_vld(),.z(t10));
    PE_fp_mul m11(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(cam_valid),.a(a13),.b(cam_R[2][1]),.out_vld(),.z(t11));
    PE_fp_mul m12(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(cam_valid),.a(a13),.b(cam_R[2][2]),.out_vld(),.z(t12));
    wire [31:0] s00,s01,s02;
    PE_fp_add a00(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(cam_valid),.a(t00),.b(t10),.out_vld(),.z(s00));
    PE_fp_add a01(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(cam_valid),.a(t01),.b(t11),.out_vld(),.z(s01));
    PE_fp_add a02(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(cam_valid),.a(t02),.b(t12),.out_vld(),.z(s02));
    assign Jlm0_0 = s00; assign Jlm0_1 = s01; assign Jlm0_2 = s02;
    // row1 * R: [0,a22,a23]*R = a22*R[1,*] + a23*R[2,*]
    wire [31:0] u10,u11,u12,v10,v11,v12,w10,w11,w12;
    PE_fp_mul m20(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(cam_valid),.a(a22),.b(cam_R[1][0]),.out_vld(),.z(u10));
    PE_fp_mul m21(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(cam_valid),.a(a22),.b(cam_R[1][1]),.out_vld(),.z(u11));
    PE_fp_mul m22(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(cam_valid),.a(a22),.b(cam_R[1][2]),.out_vld(),.z(u12));
    PE_fp_mul m23(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(cam_valid),.a(a23),.b(cam_R[2][0]),.out_vld(),.z(v10));
    PE_fp_mul m24(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(cam_valid),.a(a23),.b(cam_R[2][1]),.out_vld(),.z(v11));
    PE_fp_mul m25(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(cam_valid),.a(a23),.b(cam_R[2][2]),.out_vld(),.z(v12));
    PE_fp_add a10(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(cam_valid),.a(u10),.b(v10),.out_vld(),.z(w10));
    PE_fp_add a11(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(cam_valid),.a(u11),.b(v11),.out_vld(),.z(w11));
    PE_fp_add a12(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(cam_valid),.a(u12),.b(v12),.out_vld(),.z(w12));
    assign Jlm1_0 = w10; assign Jlm1_1 = w11; assign Jlm1_2 = w12;

    // J_pose rows: translational part = Jproj; rotational part ≈ Jproj * ( -[Pc]_x )
    // Build -[Pc]_x
    wire [31:0] negX, negY; assign negX = negf(cam_X); assign negY = negf(cam_Y);
    wire [31:0] K[0:2][0:2];
    // Build Skew(Pc) with full X,Y,Z
    Skew u_skew(.x(cam_X), .y(cam_Y), .z(cam_Z), .K(K));
    // -Skew: just negate each entry
    wire [31:0] nK[0:2][0:2];
    genvar ki,kj; generate
      for (ki=0; ki<3; ki=ki+1) begin: NKROW
        for (kj=0; kj<3; kj=kj+1) begin: NKCOL
          assign nK[ki][kj] = negf(K[ki][kj]);
        end
      end
    endgenerate

    // Pose translational block = Jproj
    wire [31:0] Jp0_t0 = a11; wire [31:0] Jp0_t1 = 32'h00000000; wire [31:0] Jp0_t2 = a13;
    wire [31:0] Jp1_t0 = 32'h00000000; wire [31:0] Jp1_t1 = a22; wire [31:0] Jp1_t2 = a23;

    // Pose rotational block: row0 = [a11,0,a13] * (-Skew(Pc)); row1 = [0,a22,a23] * (-Skew(Pc))
    wire [31:0] pr0_0,pr0_1,pr0_2, pr1_0,pr1_1,pr1_2;
    // row0
    wire [31:0] q00,q01,q02,q10_,q11_,q12_;
    PE_fp_mul pr00(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(cam_valid),.a(a11),.b(nK[0][0]),.out_vld(),.z(q00));
    PE_fp_mul pr01(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(cam_valid),.a(a11),.b(nK[0][1]),.out_vld(),.z(q01));
    PE_fp_mul pr02(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(cam_valid),.a(a11),.b(nK[0][2]),.out_vld(),.z(q02));
    PE_fp_mul pr03(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(cam_valid),.a(a13),.b(nK[2][0]),.out_vld(),.z(q10_));
    PE_fp_mul pr04(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(cam_valid),.a(a13),.b(nK[2][1]),.out_vld(),.z(q11_));
    PE_fp_mul pr05(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(cam_valid),.a(a13),.b(nK[2][2]),.out_vld(),.z(q12_));
    wire [31:0] s_r0_0,s_r0_1,s_r0_2;
    PE_fp_add pr0a(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(cam_valid),.a(q00),.b(q10_),.out_vld(),.z(s_r0_0));
    PE_fp_add pr0b(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(cam_valid),.a(q01),.b(q11_),.out_vld(),.z(s_r0_1));
    PE_fp_add pr0c(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(cam_valid),.a(q02),.b(q12_),.out_vld(),.z(s_r0_2));
    assign pr0_0 = s_r0_0; assign pr0_1 = s_r0_1; assign pr0_2 = s_r0_2;
    // row1
    wire [31:0] p10,p11,p12,p20,p21,p22; wire [31:0] s10,s11,s12;
    PE_fp_mul pr10(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(cam_valid),.a(a22),.b(nK[1][0]),.out_vld(),.z(p10));
    PE_fp_mul pr11(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(cam_valid),.a(a22),.b(nK[1][1]),.out_vld(),.z(p11));
    PE_fp_mul pr12(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(cam_valid),.a(a22),.b(nK[1][2]),.out_vld(),.z(p12));
    PE_fp_mul pr13(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(cam_valid),.a(a23),.b(nK[2][0]),.out_vld(),.z(p20));
    PE_fp_mul pr14(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(cam_valid),.a(a23),.b(nK[2][1]),.out_vld(),.z(p21));
    PE_fp_mul pr15(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(cam_valid),.a(a23),.b(nK[2][2]),.out_vld(),.z(p22));
    PE_fp_add pra(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(cam_valid),.a(p10),.b(p20),.out_vld(),.z(s10));
    PE_fp_add prb(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(cam_valid),.a(p11),.b(p21),.out_vld(),.z(s11));
    PE_fp_add prc(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(cam_valid),.a(p12),.b(p22),.out_vld(),.z(s12));
    assign pr1_0 = s10; assign pr1_1 = s11; assign pr1_2 = s12;

    // Apply row whitening (if enabled) with alpha0/alpha1 based on wht config
    wire [31:0] alpha0 = (wht_en && (cam_row_base == wht_base_row_r[7:0]) && (wht_m_r >= 1)) ? wht_diag_r[0] : 32'h3f800000;
    wire [31:0] alpha1 = (wht_en && (cam_row_base == wht_base_row_r[7:0]) && (wht_m_r >= 2)) ? wht_diag_r[1] : 32'h3f800000;
    function automatic [31:0] scale(input [31:0] a, input [31:0] s);
        reg [31:0] zt; begin scale = a; end
    endfunction
    // Scale and write to buffers (combinational assignment on cam_valid)
    integer jc;
    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
      if (rst) begin
      end else if (cam_valid && cam_ready) begin
        // row0 (cam_row_base)
        // A: landmark block 3 cols
        matrix_buf[cam_row_base][cam_col_lm_base+0] <= Jlm0_0; // scaled later if needed by upstream
        matrix_buf[cam_row_base][cam_col_lm_base+1] <= Jlm0_1;
        matrix_buf[cam_row_base][cam_col_lm_base+2] <= Jlm0_2;
        // A: pose block 6 cols (translation then rotation)
        matrix_buf[cam_row_base][cam_col_pose_base+0] <= Jp0_t0;
        matrix_buf[cam_row_base][cam_col_pose_base+1] <= Jp0_t1;
        matrix_buf[cam_row_base][cam_col_pose_base+2] <= Jp0_t2;
        matrix_buf[cam_row_base][cam_col_pose_base+3] <= pr0_0;
        matrix_buf[cam_row_base][cam_col_pose_base+4] <= pr0_1;
        matrix_buf[cam_row_base][cam_col_pose_base+5] <= pr0_2;
        b_buf[cam_row_base] <= r_u;

        // row1 (cam_row_base+1)
        matrix_buf[cam_row_base+1][cam_col_lm_base+0] <= Jlm1_0;
        matrix_buf[cam_row_base+1][cam_col_lm_base+1] <= Jlm1_1;
        matrix_buf[cam_row_base+1][cam_col_lm_base+2] <= Jlm1_2;
        matrix_buf[cam_row_base+1][cam_col_pose_base+0] <= Jp1_t0;
        matrix_buf[cam_row_base+1][cam_col_pose_base+1] <= Jp1_t1;
        matrix_buf[cam_row_base+1][cam_col_pose_base+2] <= Jp1_t2;
        matrix_buf[cam_row_base+1][cam_col_pose_base+3] <= pr1_0;
        matrix_buf[cam_row_base+1][cam_col_pose_base+4] <= pr1_1;
        matrix_buf[cam_row_base+1][cam_col_pose_base+5] <= pr1_2;
        b_buf[cam_row_base+1] <= r_v;
      end
    end

    // --------------------------------------------------------------------
    // IMU Between factor (6x6) — small-angle right-invariant approximation
    // e = [ Ri^T (tj - ti) - t_delta ; vee( sk(Ri^T Rj) ) - rot_delta ]
    // J: translation rows: wrt t_i = -I, t_j = I, wrt theta_i = -[Ri^T (tj-ti)]_x
    //     rotation rows: wrt theta_i = -I, wrt theta_j = I
    // --------------------------------------------------------------------
    input  wire                 imu_valid;
    output wire                 imu_ready;
    input  wire [7:0]           imu_row_base;      // use rows imu_row_base..imu_row_base+5
    input  wire [7:0]           imu_col_pose_i;    // 6 cols for pose i
    input  wire [7:0]           imu_col_pose_j;    // 6 cols for pose j
    input  wire [31:0]          Ri   [0:2][0:2];
    input  wire [31:0]          Rj   [0:2][0:2];
    input  wire [31:0]          R_delta [0:2][0:2]; // preintegrated ΔR_ij
    input  wire [31:0]          ti   [0:2];
    input  wire [31:0]          tj   [0:2];
    input  wire [31:0]          t_delta [0:2];
    input  wire [31:0]          rot_delta [0:2]; // desired small-angle delta (optional, else 0)

    assign imu_ready = 1'b1;

    // v = tj - ti
    wire [31:0] v01, v11, v21;
    PE_fp_sub vsub0(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(tj[0]),.b(ti[0]),.out_vld(),.z(v01));
    PE_fp_sub vsub1(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(tj[1]),.b(ti[1]),.out_vld(),.z(v11));
    PE_fp_sub vsub2(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(tj[2]),.b(ti[2]),.out_vld(),.z(v21));

    // vi = Ri^T * v (three dot products)
    // RiT rows are columns of Ri
    wire [31:0] m00,m01,m02,a0,b0;
    wire [31:0] m10,m11,m12,a1,b1;
    wire [31:0] m20,m21,m22,a2,b2;
    // row 0
    PE_fp_mul iv00(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(Ri[0][0]),.b(v01),.out_vld(),.z(m00));
    PE_fp_mul iv01(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(Ri[1][0]),.b(v11),.out_vld(),.z(m01));
    PE_fp_mul iv02(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(Ri[2][0]),.b(v21),.out_vld(),.z(m02));
    PE_fp_add ia0(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(m00),.b(m01),.out_vld(),.z(a0));
    PE_fp_add ib0(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(a0), .b(m02),.out_vld(),.z(b0));
    // row 1
    PE_fp_mul iv10(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(Ri[0][1]),.b(v01),.out_vld(),.z(m10));
    PE_fp_mul iv11(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(Ri[1][1]),.b(v11),.out_vld(),.z(m11));
    PE_fp_mul iv12(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(Ri[2][1]),.b(v21),.out_vld(),.z(m12));
    PE_fp_add ia1(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(m10),.b(m11),.out_vld(),.z(a1));
    PE_fp_add ib1(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(a1), .b(m12),.out_vld(),.z(b1));
    // row 2
    PE_fp_mul iv20(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(Ri[0][2]),.b(v01),.out_vld(),.z(m20));
    PE_fp_mul iv21(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(Ri[1][2]),.b(v11),.out_vld(),.z(m21));
    PE_fp_mul iv22(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(Ri[2][2]),.b(v21),.out_vld(),.z(m22));
    PE_fp_add ia2(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(m20),.b(m21),.out_vld(),.z(a2));
    PE_fp_add ib2(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(a2), .b(m22),.out_vld(),.z(b2));

    // vtilde = vi_b - t_delta
    wire [31:0] vt0, vt1, vt2;
    PE_fp_sub rts0(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(b0),.b(t_delta[0]),.out_vld(),.z(vt0));
    PE_fp_sub rts1(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(b1),.b(t_delta[1]),.out_vld(),.z(vt1));
    PE_fp_sub rts2(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(b2),.b(t_delta[2]),.out_vld(),.z(vt2));

    // Rt = R_delta^T, compute rt = Rt * vtilde
    wire [31:0] rt0, rt1, rt2;
    wire [31:0] rtv0a, rtv0b, rtv1a, rtv1b, rtv2a, rtv2b;
    PE_fp_mul rtv00(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[0][0]),.b(vt0),.out_vld(),.z(rtv0a));
    PE_fp_mul rtv01(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[1][0]),.b(vt1),.out_vld(),.z(rtv0b));
    PE_fp_add rtv0s(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(rtv0a),.b(rtv0b),.out_vld(),.z(rtv0a));
    PE_fp_mul rtv02(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[2][0]),.b(vt2),.out_vld(),.z(rtv0b));
    PE_fp_add rtv0f(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(rtv0a),.b(rtv0b),.out_vld(),.z(rt0));

    PE_fp_mul rtv10(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[0][1]),.b(vt0),.out_vld(),.z(rtv1a));
    PE_fp_mul rtv11(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[1][1]),.b(vt1),.out_vld(),.z(rtv1b));
    PE_fp_add rtv1s(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(rtv1a),.b(rtv1b),.out_vld(),.z(rtv1a));
    PE_fp_mul rtv12(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[2][1]),.b(vt2),.out_vld(),.z(rtv1b));
    PE_fp_add rtv1f(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(rtv1a),.b(rtv1b),.out_vld(),.z(rt1));

    PE_fp_mul rtv20(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[0][2]),.b(vt0),.out_vld(),.z(rtv2a));
    PE_fp_mul rtv21(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[1][2]),.b(vt1),.out_vld(),.z(rtv2b));
    PE_fp_add rtv2s(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(rtv2a),.b(rtv2b),.out_vld(),.z(rtv2a));
    PE_fp_mul rtv22(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[2][2]),.b(vt2),.out_vld(),.z(rtv2b));
    PE_fp_add rtv2f(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(rtv2a),.b(rtv2b),.out_vld(),.z(rt2));

    // A = Ri^T * Rj (3x3)
    // Compute columns of Rj dotted with columns of Ri
    // c00 = dot(Ri[:,0], Rj[:,0]) ... etc
    wire [31:0] c00,c01,c02,c10,c11,c12,c20,c21,c22;
    // c00
    wire [31:0] p000,p001,p002,s000,s001;
    PE_fp_mul p00(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(Ri[0][0]),.b(Rj[0][0]),.out_vld(),.z(p000));
    PE_fp_mul p01(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(Ri[1][0]),.b(Rj[1][0]),.out_vld(),.z(p001));
    PE_fp_mul p02(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(Ri[2][0]),.b(Rj[2][0]),.out_vld(),.z(p002));
    PE_fp_add s00(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(p000),.b(p001),.out_vld(),.z(s000));
    PE_fp_add s01(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(s000),.b(p002),.out_vld(),.z(c00));
    // c01
    wire [31:0] p010,p011,p012,s010,s011;
    PE_fp_mul p10(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(Ri[0][0]),.b(Rj[0][1]),.out_vld(),.z(p010));
    PE_fp_mul p11(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(Ri[1][0]),.b(Rj[1][1]),.out_vld(),.z(p011));
    PE_fp_mul p12(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(Ri[2][0]),.b(Rj[2][1]),.out_vld(),.z(p012));
    PE_fp_add s10(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(p010),.b(p011),.out_vld(),.z(s010));
    PE_fp_add s11(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(s010),.b(p012),.out_vld(),.z(c01));
    // c02
    wire [31:0] p020,p021,p022,s020,s021;
    PE_fp_mul p20(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(Ri[0][0]),.b(Rj[0][2]),.out_vld(),.z(p020));
    PE_fp_mul p21(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(Ri[1][0]),.b(Rj[1][2]),.out_vld(),.z(p021));
    PE_fp_mul p22(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(Ri[2][0]),.b(Rj[2][2]),.out_vld(),.z(p022));
    PE_fp_add s20(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(p020),.b(p021),.out_vld(),.z(s020));
    PE_fp_add s21(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(s020),.b(p022),.out_vld(),.z(c02));
    // c10
    wire [31:0] p100,p101,p102,s100,s101;
    PE_fp_mul q00(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(Ri[0][1]),.b(Rj[0][0]),.out_vld(),.z(p100));
    PE_fp_mul q01(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(Ri[1][1]),.b(Rj[1][0]),.out_vld(),.z(p101));
    PE_fp_mul q02(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(Ri[2][1]),.b(Rj[2][0]),.out_vld(),.z(p102));
    PE_fp_add t10(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(p100),.b(p101),.out_vld(),.z(s100));
    PE_fp_add t11(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),
                  .a(s100),.b(p102),.out_vld(),.z(c10));
    // c11
    wire [31:0] p110,p111,p112,s110,s111;
    PE_fp_mul q10(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(Ri[0][1]),.b(Rj[0][1]),
                  .out_vld(),.z(p110));
    PE_fp_mul q11(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(Ri[1][1]),.b(Rj[1][1]),
                  .out_vld(),.z(p111));
    PE_fp_mul q12(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(Ri[2][1]),.b(Rj[2][1]),
                  .out_vld(),.z(p112));
    PE_fp_add t20(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(p110),.b(p111),.out_vld(),.z(s110));
    PE_fp_add t21(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(s110),.b(p112),.out_vld(),.z(c11));
    // c12
    wire [31:0] p120,p121,p122,s120,s121;
    PE_fp_mul q20(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(Ri[0][1]),.b(Rj[0][2]),.out_vld(),.z(p120));
    PE_fp_mul q21(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(Ri[1][1]),.b(Rj[1][2]),.out_vld(),.z(p121));
    PE_fp_mul q22(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(Ri[2][1]),.b(Rj[2][2]),.out_vld(),.z(p122));
    PE_fp_add t30(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(p120),.b(p121),.out_vld(),.z(s120));
    PE_fp_add t31(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(s120),.b(p122),.out_vld(),.z(c12));
    // c20
    wire [31:0] p200,p201,p202,s200,s201;
    PE_fp_mul r00(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(Ri[0][2]),.b(Rj[0][0]),.out_vld(),.z(p200));
    PE_fp_mul r01(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(Ri[1][2]),.b(Rj[1][0]),.out_vld(),.z(p201));
    PE_fp_mul r02(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(Ri[2][2]),.b(Rj[2][0]),.out_vld(),.z(p202));
    PE_fp_add u10(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(p200),.b(p201),.out_vld(),.z(s200));
    PE_fp_add u11(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(s200),.b(p202),.out_vld(),.z(c20));
    // c21
    wire [31:0] p210,p211,p212,s210,s211;
    PE_fp_mul r10(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(Ri[0][2]),.b(Rj[0][1]),.out_vld(),.z(p210));
    PE_fp_mul r11(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(Ri[1][2]),.b(Rj[1][1]),.out_vld(),.z(p211));
    PE_fp_mul r12(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),
                  .a(Ri[2][2]),.b(Rj[2][1]),.out_vld(),.z(p212));
    PE_fp_add u20(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(p210),.b(p211),.out_vld(),.z(s210));
    PE_fp_add u21(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(s210),.b(p212),.out_vld(),.z(c21));
    // c22
    wire [31:0] p220,p221,p222,s220,s221;
    PE_fp_mul r20(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(Ri[0][2]),.b(Rj[0][2]),.out_vld(),.z(p220));
    PE_fp_mul r21(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(Ri[1][2]),.b(Rj[1][2]),.out_vld(),.z(p221));
    PE_fp_mul r22(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(Ri[2][2]),.b(Rj[2][2]),.out_vld(),.z(p222));
    PE_fp_add u30(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(p220),.b(p221),.out_vld(),.z(s220));
    PE_fp_add u31(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(s220),.b(p222),
                  .out_vld(),.z(c22));

    // Compute R_err = R_delta^T * C
    // Re = Rt * C, where Rt[i,k] = R_delta[k][i]
    wire [31:0] re00,re01,re02,re10,re11,re12,re20,re21,re22;
    // re00 = sum_k Rt[0][k]*C[k][0] = R_delta[k][0]*Ck0
    wire [31:0] r000,r001,r002,sr00a;
    PE_fp_mul re000(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[0][0]),.b(c00),.out_vld(),.z(r000));
    PE_fp_mul re001(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[1][0]),.b(c10),.out_vld(),.z(r001));
    PE_fp_mul re002(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[2][0]),.b(c20),.out_vld(),.z(r002));
    PE_fp_add re00a(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(r000),.b(r001),.out_vld(),.z(sr00a));
    PE_fp_add re00b(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(sr00a),.b(r002),.out_vld(),.z(re00));
    // re01
    wire [31:0] r010,r011,r012,sr01a;
    PE_fp_mul re010(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[0][0]),.b(c01),.out_vld(),.z(r010));
    PE_fp_mul re011(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[1][0]),.b(c11),.out_vld(),.z(r011));
    PE_fp_mul re012(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[2][0]),.b(c21),.out_vld(),.z(r012));
    PE_fp_add re01a(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(r010),.b(r011),.out_vld(),.z(sr01a));
    PE_fp_add re01b(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(sr01a),.b(r012),.out_vld(),.z(re01));
    // re02
    wire [31:0] r020,r021,r022,sr02a;
    PE_fp_mul re020(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[0][0]),.b(c02),.out_vld(),.z(r020));
    PE_fp_mul re021(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[1][0]),.b(c12),.out_vld(),.z(r021));
    PE_fp_mul re022(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[2][0]),.b(c22),.out_vld(),.z(r022));
    PE_fp_add re02a(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(r020),.b(r021),.out_vld(),.z(sr02a));
    PE_fp_add re02b(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(sr02a),.b(r022),.out_vld(),.z(re02));
    // re10 (use Rt[1][k] = R_delta[k][1])
    wire [31:0] r100,r101,r102,sr10a;
    PE_fp_mul re100(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[0][1]),.b(c00),.out_vld(),.z(r100));
    PE_fp_mul re101(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[1][1]),.b(c10),.out_vld(),.z(r101));
    PE_fp_mul re102(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[2][1]),.b(c20),.out_vld(),.z(r102));
    PE_fp_add re10a(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(r100),.b(r101),.out_vld(),.z(sr10a));
    PE_fp_add re10b(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(sr10a),.b(r102),.out_vld(),.z(re10));
    // re11
    wire [31:0] r110,r111,r112,sr11a;
    PE_fp_mul re110(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[0][1]),.b(c01),..out_vld(),.z(r110));
    PE_fp_mul re111(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[1][1]),.b(c11),.out_vld(),.z(r111));
    PE_fp_mul re112(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[2][1]),.b(c21),.out_vld(),.z(r112));
    PE_fp_add re11a(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(r110),.b(r111),.out_vld(),.z(sr11a));
    PE_fp_add re11b(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(sr11a),.b(r112),.out_vld(),.z(re11));
    // re12
    wire [31:0] r120,r121,r122,sr12a;
    PE_fp_mul re120(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[0][1]),.b(c02),.out_vld(),.z(r120));
    PE_fp_mul re121(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[1][1]),.b(c12),.out_vld(),.z(r121));
    PE_fp_mul re122(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[2][1]),.b(c22),.out_vld(),.z(r122));
    PE_fp_add re12a(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(r120),.b(r121),.out_vld(),.z(sr12a));
    PE_fp_add re12b(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(sr12a),.b(r122),.out_vld(),.z(re12));
    // re20
    wire [31:0] r200,r201,r202,sr20a;
    PE_fp_mul re200(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[0][2]),.b(c00),.out_vld(),.z(r200));
    PE_fp_mul re201(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[1][2]),.b(c10),.out_vld(),.z(r201));
    PE_fp_mul re202(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[2][2]),.b(c20),.out_vld(),.z(r202));
    PE_fp_add re20a(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(r200),.b(r201),.out_vld(),.z(sr20a));
    PE_fp_add re20b(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(sr20a),.b(r202),.out_vld(),.z(re20));
    // re21
    wire [31:0] r210,r211,r212,sr21a;
    PE_fp_mul re210(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[0][2]),.b(c01),.out_vld(),.z(r210));
    PE_fp_mul re211(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[1][2]),.b(c11),.out_vld(),.z(r211));
    PE_fp_mul re212(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[2][2]),.b(c21),.out_vld(),.z(r212));
    PE_fp_add re21a(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(r210),.b(r211),.out_vld(),.z(sr21a));
    PE_fp_add re21b(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(sr21a),.b(r212),.out_vld(),.z(re21));
    // re22
    wire [31:0] r220,r221,r222,sr22a;
    PE_fp_mul re220(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[0][2]),.b(c02),.out_vld(),.z(r220));
    PE_fp_mul re221(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[1][2]),.b(c12),.out_vld(),.z(r221));
    PE_fp_mul re222(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[2][2]),.b(c22),.out_vld(),.z(r222));
    PE_fp_add re22a(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(r220),.b(r221),.out_vld(),.z(sr22a));
    PE_fp_add re22b(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(sr22a),.b(r222),.out_vld(),.z(re22));

    // vee(Re - Re^T)/2 -> v = [vx, vy, vz]
    localparam [31:0] FP_HALF = 32'h3f000000; // 0.5f
    wire [31:0] dxy0,dxy1,dxy2; // diffs
    PE_fp_sub dv0(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(re21),.b(re12),.out_vld(),.z(dxy0));
    PE_fp_sub dv1(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(re02),.b(re20),.out_vld(),.z(dxy1));
    PE_fp_sub dv2(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(re10),.b(re01),.out_vld(),.z(dxy2));
    wire [31:0] vx,vy,vz;
    PE_fp_mul vxm(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(dxy0),.b(FP_HALF),.out_vld(),.z(vx));
    PE_fp_mul vym(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(dxy1),.b(FP_HALF),.out_vld(),.z(vy));
    PE_fp_mul vzm(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(dxy2),.b(FP_HALF),.out_vld(),.z(vz));

    // cos and sin terms
    wire [31:0] tr01,tr02,trsum, tr_minus1, cos_term;
    PE_fp_add tr0(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(re00),.b(re11),.out_vld(),.z(tr01));
    PE_fp_add tr1(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(tr01),.b(re22),.out_vld(),.z(trsum));
    localparam [31:0] FP_ONE = 32'h3f800000;
    wire [31:0] neg_one = 32'hbf800000;
    PE_fp_add tm1(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(trsum),.b(neg_one),.out_vld(),.z(tr_minus1));
    PE_fp_mul c_half(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(tr_minus1),.b(FP_HALF),.out_vld(),.z(cos_term));

    // s = 0.5 * ||v||
    wire [31:0] vx2,vy2,vz2, sumv2, vnorm, s_term;
    PE_fp_mul vx2m(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(vx),.b(vx),.out_vld(),.z(vx2));
    PE_fp_mul vy2m(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(vy),.b(vy),.out_vld(),.z(vy2));
    PE_fp_mul vz2m(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(vz),.b(vz),.out_vld(),.z(vz2));
    wire [31:0] s01;
    PE_fp_add sv0(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(vx2),.b(vy2),.out_vld(),.z(s01));
    PE_fp_add sv1(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(s01),.b(vz2),.out_vld(),.z(sumv2));
    PE_fp_sqrt sqv(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(sumv2),.out_vld(),.z(vnorm));
    PE_fp_mul sh(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(vnorm),.b(FP_HALF),.out_vld(),.z(s_term));

    // theta = atan2(s, c)
    wire [31:0] theta; wire t_vld;
    Atan2Cordic atan2u(.clk(clk), .rstn(~rst), .in_vld(imu_valid), .y(s_term), .x(cos_term), .out_vld(t_vld), .theta(theta));

    // scale = theta / (2*s)
    localparam [31:0] FP_TWO = 32'h40000000;
    wire [31:0] two_s, scale;
    PE_fp_mul two_s_mul(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(t_vld),.a(FP_TWO),.b(s_term),.out_vld(),.z(two_s));
    PE_fp_div scdiv(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(t_vld),.a(theta),.b(two_s),.out_vld(),.z(scale));

    // rR = scale * v - rot_delta
    wire [31:0] sv0,sv1,sv2; wire [31:0] rR0, rR1, rR2;
    PE_fp_mul svx(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(t_vld),.a(scale),.b(vx),.out_vld(),.z(sv0));
    PE_fp_mul svy(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(t_vld),.a(scale),.b(vy),.out_vld(),.z(sv1));
    PE_fp_mul svz(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(t_vld),.a(scale),.b(vz),.out_vld(),.z(sv2));
    PE_fp_sub rRsub0(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(t_vld),.a(sv0),.b(rot_delta[0]),.out_vld(),.z(rR0));
    PE_fp_sub rRsub1(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(t_vld),.a(sv1),.b(rot_delta[1]),.out_vld(),.z(rR1));
    PE_fp_sub rRsub2(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(t_vld),.a(sv2),.b(rot_delta[2]),.out_vld(),.z(rR2));

    // Write 6 rows into matrix_buf and b_buf
    // Row weights (whitening)
    wire [31:0] ialpha0 = (wht_en && (imu_row_base == wht_base_row_r[7:0]) && (wht_m_r >= 1)) ? wht_diag_r[0] : 32'h3f800000;
    wire [31:0] ialpha1 = (wht_en && (imu_row_base == wht_base_row_r[7:0]) && (wht_m_r >= 2)) ? wht_diag_r[1] : 32'h3f800000;
    wire [31:0] ialpha2 = (wht_en && (imu_row_base == wht_base_row_r[7:0]) && (wht_m_r >= 3)) ? wht_diag_r[2] : 32'h3f800000;
    wire [31:0] ialpha3 = (wht_en && (imu_row_base == wht_base_row_r[7:0]) && (wht_m_r >= 4)) ? wht_diag_r[3] : 32'h3f800000;
    wire [31:0] ialpha4 = (wht_en && (imu_row_base == wht_base_row_r[7:0]) && (wht_m_r >= 5)) ? wht_diag_r[4] : 32'h3f800000;
    wire [31:0] ialpha5 = (wht_en && (imu_row_base == wht_base_row_r[7:0]) && (wht_m_r >= 6)) ? wht_diag_r[5] : 32'h3f800000;

    // Constants
    localparam [31:0] FP_ONE = 32'h3f800000;
    localparam [31:0] FP_ZERO= 32'h00000000;

    // Scale helpers
    wire [31:0] rt0s, rt1s, rt2s, rR0s, rR1s, rR2s;
    PE_fp_mul sc_rt0(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(rt0),.b(ialpha0),.out_vld(),.z(rt0s));
    PE_fp_mul sc_rt1(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(rt1),.b(ialpha1),.out_vld(),.z(rt1s));
    PE_fp_mul sc_rt2(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(rt2),.b(ialpha2),.out_vld(),.z(rt2s));
    PE_fp_mul sc_rR0(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(rR0),.b(ialpha3),.out_vld(),.z(rR0s));
    PE_fp_mul sc_rR1(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(rR1),.b(ialpha4),.out_vld(),.z(rR1s));
    PE_fp_mul sc_rR2(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(rR2),.b(ialpha5),
                     .out_vld(),.z(rR2s));

    // Write matrix and b (when imu_valid)
    integer ii;
    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
      if (rst) begin
      end else if (imu_valid && imu_ready) begin
        // Precompute skew(vi_b) and Rt*Ri^T matrix for jacobians
        wire [31:0] Kvi[0:2][0:2];
        Skew sk_vi(.x(b0), .y(b1), .z(b2), .K(Kvi));

        // Rt = R_delta^T already implied by using columns of R_delta as rows
        // Compute M = Rt * Ri^T (3x3)
        wire [31:0] m00,m01,m02,m10,m11,m12,m20,m21,m22;
        // Row0 of Rt times Ri^T columns -> use rows of Ri for Ri^T columns
        wire [31:0] m0a0,m0a1,m0a2,m0b0,m0b1,m0b2;
        PE_fp_mul m0mul0(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[0][0]),.b(Ri[0][0]),.out_vld(),.z(m0a0));
        PE_fp_mul m0mul1(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[1][0]),.b(Ri[1][0]),.out_vld(),.z(m0a1));
        PE_fp_mul m0mul2(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[2][0]),.b(Ri[2][0]),.out_vld(),.z(m0a2));
        PE_fp_add m0add0(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(m0a0),.b(m0a1),.out_vld(),.z(m0b0));
        PE_fp_add m0add1(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(m0b0),.b(m0a2),.out_vld(),.z(m00));

        PE_fp_mul m0mul3(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[0][0]),.b(Ri[0][1]),.out_vld(),.z(m0a0));
        PE_fp_mul m0mul4(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[1][0]),.b(Ri[1][1]),.out_vld(),.z(m0a1));
        PE_fp_mul m0mul5(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[2][0]),.b(Ri[2][1]),.out_vld(),.z(m0a2));
        PE_fp_add m0add2(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(m0a0),.b(m0a1),.out_vld(),.z(m0b1));
        PE_fp_add m0add3(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(m0b1),.b(m0a2),.out_vld(),.z(m01));

        PE_fp_mul m0mul6(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[0][0]),.b(Ri[0][2]),.out_vld(),.z(m0a0));
        PE_fp_mul m0mul7(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[1][0]),.b(Ri[1][2]),.out_vld(),.z(m0a1));
        PE_fp_mul m0mul8(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[2][0]),.b(Ri[2][2]),.out_vld(),.z(m0a2));
        PE_fp_add m0add4(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(m0a0),.b(m0a1),.out_vld(),.z(m0b2));
        PE_fp_add m0add5(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(m0b2),.b(m0a2),.out_vld(),.z(m02));

        // Row1
        wire [31:0] m1a0,m1a1,m1a2,m1b0,m1b1,m1b2;
        PE_fp_mul m1mul0(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[0][1]),.b(Ri[0][0]),.out_vld(),.z(m1a0));
        PE_fp_mul m1mul1(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[1][1]),.b(Ri[1][0]),.out_vld(),.z(m1a1));
        PE_fp_mul m1mul2(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[2][1]),.b(Ri[2][0]),.out_vld(),.z(m1a2));
        PE_fp_add m1add0(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(m1a0),.b(m1a1),.out_vld(),.z(m1b0));
        PE_fp_add m1add1(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(m1b0),.b(m1a2),.out_vld(),.z(m10));

        PE_fp_mul m1mul3(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[0][1]),.b(Ri[0][1]),.out_vld(),.z(m1a0));
        PE_fp_mul m1mul4(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[1][1]),.b(Ri[1][1]),.out_vld(),.z(m1a1));
        PE_fp_mul m1mul5(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[2][1]),.b(Ri[2][1]),.out_vld(),.z(m1a2));
        PE_fp_add m1add2(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(m1a0),.b(m1a1),.out_vld(),.z(m1b1));
        PE_fp_add m1add3(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(m1b1),.b(m1a2),.out_vld(),.z(m11));

        PE_fp_mul m1mul6(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[0][1]),.b(Ri[0][2]),.out_vld(),.z(m1a0));
        PE_fp_mul m1mul7(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[1][1]),.b(Ri[1][2]),.out_vld(),.z(m1a1));
        PE_fp_mul m1mul8(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[2][1]),.b(Ri[2][2]),.out_vld(),.z(m1a2));
        PE_fp_add m1add4(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(m1a0),.b(m1a1),.out_vld(),.z(m1b2));
        PE_fp_add m1add5(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(m1b2),.b(m1a2),.out_vld(),.z(m12));

        // Row2
        wire [31:0] m2a0,m2a1,m2a2,m2b0,m2b1,m2b2;
        PE_fp_mul m2mul0(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[0][2]),.b(Ri[0][0]),.out_vld(),.z(m2a0));
        PE_fp_mul m2mul1(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[1][2]),.b(Ri[1][0]),.out_vld(),.z(m2a1));
        PE_fp_mul m2mul2(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[2][2]),.b(Ri[2][0]),.out_vld(),.z(m2a2));
        PE_fp_add m2add0(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(m2a0),.b(m2a1),.out_vld(),.z(m2b0));
        PE_fp_add m2add1(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(m2b0),.b(m2a2),.out_vld(),.z(m20));

        PE_fp_mul m2mul3(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[0][2]),.b(Ri[0][1]),.out_vld(),.z(m2a0));
        PE_fp_mul m2mul4(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[1][2]),.b(Ri[1][1]),.out_vld(),.z(m2a1));
        PE_fp_mul m2mul5(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[2][2]),.b(Ri[2][1]),.out_vld(),.z(m2a2));
        PE_fp_add m2add2(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(m2a0),.b(m2a1),.out_vld(),.z(m2b1));
        PE_fp_add m2add3(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(m2b1),.b(m2a2),.out_vld(),.z(m21));

        PE_fp_mul m2mul6(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[0][2]),.b(Ri[0][2]),.out_vld(),.z(m2a0));
        PE_fp_mul m2mul7(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[1][2]),.b(Ri[1][2]),.out_vld(),.z(m2a1));
        PE_fp_mul m2mul8(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[2][2]),.b(Ri[2][2]),.out_vld(),.z(m2a2));
        PE_fp_add m2add4(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(m2a0),.b(m2a1),.out_vld(),.z(m2b2));
        PE_fp_add m2add5(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(m2b2),.b(m2a2),.out_vld(),.z(m22));

        // Rt * Kvi for rotation part of translation rows
        wire [31:0] rk00,rk01,rk02,rk10,rk11,rk12,rk20,rk21,rk22;
        // row0
        wire [31:0] rk0a0,rk0a1,rk0a2;
        PE_fp_mul rk000(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[0][0]),.b(Kvi[0][0]),.out_vld(),.z(rk0a0));
        PE_fp_mul rk001(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[1][0]),.b(Kvi[1][0]),.out_vld(),.z(rk0a1));
        PE_fp_mul rk002(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[2][0]),.b(Kvi[2][0]),.out_vld(),.z(rk0a2));
        PE_fp_add rk00a(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(rk0a0),.b(rk0a1),.out_vld(),.z(rk0a0));
        PE_fp_add rk00b(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(rk0a0),.b(rk0a2),.out_vld(),.z(rk00));
        // row0 col1
        PE_fp_mul rk010(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[0][0]),.b(Kvi[0][1]),.out_vld(),.z(rk0a0));
        PE_fp_mul rk011(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[1][0]),.b(Kvi[1][1]),.out_vld(),.z(rk0a1));
        PE_fp_mul rk012(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[2][0]),.b(Kvi[2][1]),.out_vld(),.z(rk0a2));
        PE_fp_add rk01a(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(rk0a0),.b(rk0a1),.out_vld(),.z(rk0a0));
        PE_fp_add rk01b(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(rk0a0),.b(rk0a2),.out_vld(),.z(rk01));
        // row0 col2
        PE_fp_mul rk020(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[0][0]),.b(Kvi[0][2]),.out_vld(),.z(rk0a0));
        PE_fp_mul rk021(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[1][0]),.b(Kvi[1][2]),.out_vld(),.z(rk0a1));
        PE_fp_mul rk022(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[2][0]),.b(Kvi[2][2]),.out_vld(),.z(rk0a2));
        PE_fp_add rk02a(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(rk0a0),.b(rk0a1),.out_vld(),.z(rk0a0));
        PE_fp_add rk02b(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(rk0a0),.b(rk0a2),.out_vld(),.z(rk02));

        // row1
        wire [31:0] rk1a0,rk1a1,rk1a2;
        PE_fp_mul rk100(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[0][1]),.b(Kvi[0][0]),.out_vld(),.z(rk1a0));
        PE_fp_mul rk101(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[1][1]),.b(Kvi[1][0]),.out_vld(),.z(rk1a1));
        PE_fp_mul rk102(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[2][1]),.b(Kvi[2][0]),.out_vld(),.z(rk1a2));
        PE_fp_add rk10a(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(rk1a0),.b(rk1a1),.out_vld(),.z(rk1a0));
        PE_fp_add rk10b(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(rk1a0),.b(rk1a2),.out_vld(),.z(rk10));

        PE_fp_mul rk110(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[0][1]),.b(Kvi[0][1]),.out_vld(),.z(rk1a0));
        PE_fp_mul rk111(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[1][1]),.b(Kvi[1][1]),.out_vld(),.z(rk1a1));
        PE_fp_mul rk112(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[2][1]),.b(Kvi[2][1]),.out_vld(),.z(rk1a2));
        PE_fp_add rk11a(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(rk1a0),.b(rk1a1),.out_vld(),.z(rk1a0));
        PE_fp_add rk11b(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(rk1a0),.b(rk1a2),.out_vld(),.z(rk11));

        PE_fp_mul rk120(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[0][1]),.b(Kvi[0][2]),.out_vld(),.z(rk1a0));
        PE_fp_mul rk121(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[1][1]),.b(Kvi[1][2]),.out_vld(),.z(rk1a1));
        PE_fp_mul rk122(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[2][1]),.b(Kvi[2][2]),.out_vld(),.z(rk1a2));
        PE_fp_add rk12a(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(rk1a0),.b(rk1a1),.out_vld(),.z(rk1a0));
        PE_fp_add rk12b(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(rk1a0),.b(rk1a2),.out_vld(),.z(rk12));

        // row2
        wire [31:0] rk2a0,rk2a1,rk2a2;
        PE_fp_mul rk200(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[0][2]),.b(Kvi[0][0]),.out_vld(),.z(rk2a0));
        PE_fp_mul rk201(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[1][2]),.b(Kvi[1][0]),.out_vld(),.z(rk2a1));
        PE_fp_mul rk202(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[2][2]),.b(Kvi[2][0]),.out_vld(),.z(rk2a2));
        PE_fp_add rk20a(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(rk2a0),.b(rk2a1),.out_vld(),.z(rk2a0));
        PE_fp_add rk20b(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(rk2a0),.b(rk2a2),.out_vld(),.z(rk20));

        PE_fp_mul rk210(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[0][2]),.b(Kvi[0][1]),.out_vld(),.z(rk2a0));
        PE_fp_mul rk211(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[1][2]),.b(Kvi[1][1]),.out_vld(),.z(rk2a1));
        PE_fp_mul rk212(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[2][2]),.b(Kvi[2][1]),.out_vld(),.z(rk2a2));
        PE_fp_add rk21a(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(rk2a0),.b(rk2a1),.out_vld(),.z(rk2a0));
        PE_fp_add rk21b(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(rk2a0),.b(rk2a2),.out_vld(),.z(rk21));

        PE_fp_mul rk220(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[0][2]),.b(Kvi[0][2]),.out_vld(),.z(rk2a0));
        PE_fp_mul rk221(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[1][2]),.b(Kvi[1][2]),.out_vld(),.z(rk2a1));
        PE_fp_mul rk222(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(R_delta[2][2]),.b(Kvi[2][2]),.out_vld(),.z(rk2a2));
        PE_fp_add rk22a(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(rk2a0),.b(rk2a1),.out_vld(),.z(rk2a0));
        PE_fp_add rk22b(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(imu_valid),.a(rk2a0),.b(rk2a2),.out_vld(),.z(rk22));

        // Constants
        localparam [31:0] FP_NEG_ONE = 32'hbf800000;

        // Rows 0..2: translation residual and jacobians with ΔR^T left-multiplication
        // Row 0
        // Pose i translation block = -M row0
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+0][imu_col_pose_i+0] <= negf(m00);
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+0][imu_col_pose_i+1] <= negf(m01);
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+0][imu_col_pose_i+2] <= negf(m02);
        // Pose i rotation block = -(Rt*Kvi) row0
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+0][imu_col_pose_i+3] <= negf(rk00);
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+0][imu_col_pose_i+4] <= negf(rk01);
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+0][imu_col_pose_i+5] <= negf(rk02);
        // Pose j translation block = +M row0, rotation zeros
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+0][imu_col_pose_j+0] <= m00;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+0][imu_col_pose_j+1] <= m01;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+0][imu_col_pose_j+2] <= m02;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+0][imu_col_pose_j+3] <= FP_ZERO;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+0][imu_col_pose_j+4] <= FP_ZERO;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+0][imu_col_pose_j+5] <= FP_ZERO;
        b_buf[imu_row_base+0] <= rt0s;

        // Row 1
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+1][imu_col_pose_i+0] <= negf(m10);
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+1][imu_col_pose_i+1] <= negf(m11);
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+1][imu_col_pose_i+2] <= negf(m12);
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+1][imu_col_pose_i+3] <= negf(rk10);
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+1][imu_col_pose_i+4] <= negf(rk11);
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+1][imu_col_pose_i+5] <= negf(rk12);
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+1][imu_col_pose_j+0] <= m10;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+1][imu_col_pose_j+1] <= m11;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+1][imu_col_pose_j+2] <= m12;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+1][imu_col_pose_j+3] <= FP_ZERO;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+1][imu_col_pose_j+4] <= FP_ZERO;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+1][imu_col_pose_j+5] <= FP_ZERO;
        b_buf[imu_row_base+1] <= rt1s;

        // Row 2
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+2][imu_col_pose_i+0] <= negf(m20);
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+2][imu_col_pose_i+1] <= negf(m21);
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+2][imu_col_pose_i+2] <= negf(m22);
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+2][imu_col_pose_i+3] <= negf(rk20);
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+2][imu_col_pose_i+4] <= negf(rk21);
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+2][imu_col_pose_i+5] <= negf(rk22);
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+2][imu_col_pose_j+0] <= m20;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+2][imu_col_pose_j+1] <= m21;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+2][imu_col_pose_j+2] <= m22;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+2][imu_col_pose_j+3] <= FP_ZERO;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+2][imu_col_pose_j+4] <= FP_ZERO;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+2][imu_col_pose_j+5] <= FP_ZERO;
        b_buf[imu_row_base+2] <= rt2s;

        // Rows 3..5: rotation residual
        // Row 3: pose i rot block = -I, pose j rot block = +I
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+3][imu_col_pose_i+0] <= FP_ZERO;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+3][imu_col_pose_i+1] <= FP_ZERO;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+3][imu_col_pose_i+2] <= FP_ZERO;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+3][imu_col_pose_i+3] <= FP_NEG_ONE;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+3][imu_col_pose_i+4] <= FP_ZERO;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+3][imu_col_pose_i+5] <= FP_ZERO;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+3][imu_col_pose_j+0] <= FP_ZERO;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+3][imu_col_pose_j+1] <= FP_ZERO;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+3][imu_col_pose_j+2] <= FP_ZERO;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+3][imu_col_pose_j+3] <= FP_ONE;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+3][imu_col_pose_j+4] <= FP_ZERO;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+3][imu_col_pose_j+5] <= FP_ZERO;
        b_buf[imu_row_base+3] <= rR0s;

        // Row 4
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+4][imu_col_pose_i+0] <= FP_ZERO;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+4][imu_col_pose_i+1] <= FP_ZERO;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+4][imu_col_pose_i+2] <= FP_ZERO;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+4][imu_col_pose_i+3] <= FP_ZERO;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+4][imu_col_pose_i+4] <= FP_NEG_ONE;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+4][imu_col_pose_i+5] <= FP_ZERO;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+4][imu_col_pose_j+0] <= FP_ZERO;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+4][imu_col_pose_j+1] <= FP_ZERO;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+4][imu_col_pose_j+2] <= FP_ZERO;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+4][imu_col_pose_j+3] <= FP_ZERO;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+4][imu_col_pose_j+4] <= FP_ONE;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+4][imu_col_pose_j+5] <= FP_ZERO;
        b_buf[imu_row_base+4] <= rR1s;

        // Row 5
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+5][imu_col_pose_i+0] <= FP_ZERO;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+5][imu_col_pose_i+1] <= FP_ZERO;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+5][imu_col_pose_i+2] <= FP_ZERO;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+5][imu_col_pose_i+3] <= FP_ZERO;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+5][imu_col_pose_i+4] <= FP_ZERO;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+5][imu_col_pose_i+5] <= FP_NEG_ONE;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+5][imu_col_pose_j+0] <= FP_ZERO;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+5][imu_col_pose_j+1] <= FP_ZERO;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+5][imu_col_pose_j+2] <= FP_ZERO;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+5][imu_col_pose_j+3] <= FP_ZERO;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+5][imu_col_pose_j+4] <= FP_ZERO;
        matrix_buf[imu_row_base+5][imu_col_pose_j+5] <= FP_ONE;
        b_buf[imu_row_base+5] <= rR2s;
      end
    end

    // --------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Planning: State Cost Factor e = Q^{1/2} * x_k  (quadratic penalty)
    // x layout (example): [p(3), r(3), v(3), w(3)] up to ST_MAX
    // This writes a diagonal block row with Q^{1/2} into A, and b=0
    // --------------------------------------------------------------------
    input  wire                 plan_cost_valid;
    output wire                 plan_cost_ready;
    input  wire [7:0]           plan_row_base;    // starting row
    input  wire [7:0]           plan_col_base;    // starting col (state block)
    input  wire [7:0]           plan_dim;         // active state dim (<= ST_MAX, <= N)
    input  wire [31:0]          Qsqrt_diag [0:ST_MAX-1];

    assign plan_cost_ready = 1'b1;

    integer qi;
    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
      if (rst) begin
      end else if (plan_cost_valid && plan_cost_ready) begin
        for (qi=0; qi<ST_MAX; qi=qi+1) begin
          if (qi < plan_dim) begin
            matrix_buf[plan_row_base+qi][plan_col_base+qi] <= Qsqrt_diag[qi];
            b_buf[plan_row_base+qi] <= 32'h00000000; // 0
          end
        end
      end
    end

    // --------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Planning: Dynamics Factor e = P^{1/2} * ( x_{k+1} - (A x_k + B u_k) )
    // Writes rows: [-P^{1/2} A  -P^{1/2} B | I*P^{1/2}] at row_base..row_base+dim-1
    // col_xk = pose/state k base, col_uk = control base, col_xkp1 = next state base
    // --------------------------------------------------------------------
    input  wire                 dyn_valid;
    output wire                 dyn_ready;
    input  wire [7:0]           dyn_row_base;
    input  wire [7:0]           dyn_dim;         // <= ST_MAX
    input  wire [7:0]           dyn_col_xk;
    input  wire [7:0]           dyn_col_uk;
    input  wire [7:0]           dyn_col_xkp1;
    // A (dim x dim) and B (dim x cdim) in row-major
    input  wire [31:0]          A_blk [0:ST_MAX-1][0:ST_MAX-1];
    input  wire [31:0]          B_blk [0:ST_MAX-1][0:CT_MAX-1];
    input  wire [31:0]          Psqrt_diag [0:ST_MAX-1];

    assign dyn_ready = 1'b1;

    integer di,dj;
    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
      if (rst) begin
      end else if (dyn_valid && dyn_ready) begin
        // Left blocks: -P^{1/2} * A and -P^{1/2} * B
        for (di=0; di<ST_MAX; di=di+1) begin
          if (di < dyn_dim) begin
            for (dj=0; dj<ST_MAX; dj=dj+1) begin
              if (dj < dyn_dim) begin
                // -Psqrt * A
                wire [31:0] negA;
                wire [31:0] sAj;
                // negate A
                function automatic [31:0] negf(input [31:0] a); negf = {~a[31], a[30:0]}; endfunction
                assign negA = negf(A_blk[di][dj]);
                PE_fp_mul mulPA(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(1'b1),
                                 .a(Psqrt_diag[di]), .b(negA), .out_vld(), .z(sAj));
                matrix_buf[dyn_row_base+di][dyn_col_xk+dj] <= sAj;
              end
            end
            for (dj=0; dj<CT_MAX; dj=dj+1) begin
              // -Psqrt * B
              wire [31:0] negB;
              wire [31:0] sBj;
              function automatic [31:0] negf(input [31:0] a); negf = {~a[31], a[30:0]}; endfunction
              assign negB = negf(B_blk[di][dj]);
              PE_fp_mul mulPB(.clk(clk),.rstn(~rst),.in_vld(1'b1),
                               .a(Psqrt_diag[di]), .b(negB), .out_vld(), .z(sBj));
              matrix_buf[dyn_row_base+di][dyn_col_uk+dj] <= sBj;
            end
            // Right block: +P^{1/2} * I to x_{k+1}
            matrix_buf[dyn_row_base+di][dyn_col_xkp1+di] <= Psqrt_diag[di];
            // b = 0
            b_buf[dyn_row_base+di] <= 32'h00000000;
          end
        end
      end
    end

    // --------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Control: Input Cost Factor e = R^{1/2} * u_k
    // Writes diagonal block at control columns
    // --------------------------------------------------------------------
    input  wire                 ctrl_cost_valid;
    output wire                 ctrl_cost_ready;
    input  wire [7:0]           ctrl_row_base;
    input  wire [7:0]           ctrl_col_base;
    input  wire [7:0]           ctrl_dim; // <= CT_MAX
    input  wire [31:0]          Rsqrt_diag [0:CT_MAX-1];

    assign ctrl_cost_ready = 1'b1;

    integer ci;
    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
      if (rst) begin
      end else if (ctrl_cost_valid && ctrl_cost_ready) begin
        for (ci=0; ci<CT_MAX; ci=ci+1) begin
          if (ci < ctrl_dim) begin
            matrix_buf[ctrl_row_base+ci][ctrl_col_base+ci] <= Rsqrt_diag[ci];
            b_buf[ctrl_row_base+ci] <= 32'h00000000;
          end
        end
      end
    end

    // Dense write path from host with optional diagonal whitening using OP/PE_fp_mul
    reg        load_is_b_r;
    reg [7:0]  load_row_r;
    reg [7:0]  load_col_r;

    // Select whitening coefficient by absolute row
    wire [2:0] resid_idx = (load_row >= wht_base_row_r[7:0]) ? (load_row[2:0] - wht_base_row_r[2:0]) : 3'd7;
    wire [31:0] alpha = (wht_en && (resid_idx < wht_m_r)) ? wht_diag_r[resid_idx] : 32'h3f800000; // 1.0

    wire [31:0] mul_z;
    wire        mul_out_vld;
    PE_fp_mul u_wht_mul(
        .clk(clk), .rstn(~rst), .in_vld(load_valid),
        .a(alpha), .b(load_data), .out_vld(mul_out_vld), .z(mul_z)
    );

    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst) begin
            load_is_b_r <= 1'b0;
            load_row_r  <= 8'h0;
            load_col_r  <= 8'h0;
        end else begin
            if (load_valid) begin
                load_is_b_r <= load_is_b;
                load_row_r  <= load_row;
                load_col_r  <= load_col;
            end
            if (mul_out_vld) begin
                if (load_is_b_r) begin
                    if (load_row_r < M) begin
                        b_buf[load_row_r] <= mul_z;
                    end
                end else begin
                    if ((load_row_r < M) && (load_col_r < N)) begin
                        matrix_buf[load_row_r][load_col_r] <= mul_z;
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    // --------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Row emission FSM: stream whitened rows [0..cfg_m-1] to downstream
    // --------------------------------------------------------------------
    localparam S_IDLE = 2'd0,
               S_EMIT = 2'd1;
    reg [1:0]  e_state;
    reg [7:0]  e_row;

    assign row_valid = (e_state == S_EMIT);
    assign row_idx   = e_row;

    genvar oj;
    generate
      for (oj = 0; oj < N; oj = oj + 1) begin : ROW_MAP
        assign row_A[oj] = (oj < cfg_n) ? matrix_buf[e_row][oj] : 32'h0;
      end
    endgenerate
    assign row_b = b_buf[e_row];

    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
      if (rst) begin
        e_state   <= S_IDLE;
        e_row     <= 8'h0;
        emit_done <= 1'b0;
      end else begin
        emit_done <= 1'b0;
        case (e_state)
          S_IDLE: begin
            if (emit_start) begin
              e_row   <= 8'h0;
              e_state <= S_EMIT;
            end
          end
          S_EMIT: begin
            if (row_ready) begin
              if (e_row + 8'd1 >= cfg_m) begin
                e_state   <= S_IDLE;
                emit_done <= 1'b1;
              end else begin
                e_row <= e_row + 8'd1;
              end
            end
          end
          default: e_state <= S_IDLE;
        endcase
      end
    end

endmodule
```
