好的，我现在给出完整的、可综合的 Axb.sv，包含 Camera/IMU/Prior 三种因子的全部微程序细节，精确到每一拍的 PE 调度与数据流。

```systemverilog
// ============================================================================
// Axb.sv: Unified Factor SIMD with Shared PE Pool
// Supports: Camera(2x9), IMU(6x12), Prior(6x6) factors
// Author: Generated for hardware-accelerated factor graph optimization
// ============================================================================
module Axb #(
    parameter N = 24,        // Max columns (variables)
    parameter M = 64,        // Max rows (residuals)
    parameter NUM_MUL = 16,  // Shared multiplier pool
    parameter NUM_ADD = 12,  // Shared adder pool
    parameter NUM_SUB = 8    // Shared subtractor pool
)(
    input  wire                 clk,
    input  wire                 rst,

    // Problem size configuration
    input  wire [7:0]           cfg_m,  // Effective number of rows
    input  wire [7:0]           cfg_n,  // Effective number of columns

    // ========================================================================
    // Unified Factor Input Port
    // ========================================================================
    input  wire                 factor_valid,
    output reg                  factor_ready,
    input  wire [1:0]           factor_type,    // 0=Camera, 1=IMU, 2=Prior
    input  wire [7:0]           factor_row_base,
    input  wire [2:0]           factor_rows,    // Number of rows: 2 or 6

    // Column base addresses (up to 2 variable blocks)
    input  wire [7:0]           col_var0,       // Pose or landmark
    input  wire [7:0]           col_var1,       // Pose_j (IMU) or landmark (Camera)

    // Row whitening coefficients (alpha_k = robust_weight_k / sigma_k)
    input  wire [31:0]          alpha [0:5],

    // Unified payload (interpreted by factor_type)
    // Camera-specific fields
    input  wire [31:0]          cam_fx, cam_fy, cam_cx, cam_cy,
    input  wire [31:0]          cam_z_u, cam_z_v,  // Pixel measurement
    input  wire [31:0]          cam_Pc_X, cam_Pc_Y, cam_Pc_Z, cam_Pc_invZ,
    input  wire [31:0]          cam_Rcw [0:2][0:2],

    // IMU/Prior shared fields
    input  wire [31:0]          R0 [0:2][0:2],  // Ri (IMU/Prior) or Rp (Prior)
    input  wire [31:0]          R1 [0:2][0:2],  // Rj (IMU only)
    input  wire [31:0]          Rd [0:2][0:2],  // ΔR (IMU only)
    input  wire [31:0]          t0 [0:2],       // ti (IMU/Prior) or tp (Prior)
    input  wire [31:0]          t1 [0:2],       // tj (IMU only)
    input  wire [31:0]          td [0:2],       // Δt (IMU only)

    // ========================================================================
    // Host load interface (for testing/debug)
    // ========================================================================
    input  wire                 load_valid,
    output wire                 load_ready,
    input  wire                 load_is_b,
    input  wire [7:0]           load_row,
    input  wire [7:0]           load_col,
    input  wire [31:0]          load_data,

    // ========================================================================
    // Row emission to downstream QR
    // ========================================================================
    input  wire                 emit_start,
    output reg                  emit_done,
    output wire                 row_valid,
    input  wire                 row_ready,
    output wire [7:0]           row_idx,
    output wire [31:0]          row_A [0:N-1],
    output wire [31:0]          row_b
);

    // ========================================================================
    // On-chip buffers
    // ========================================================================
    reg [31:0] matrix_buf [0:M-1][0:N-1];
    reg [31:0] b_buf      [0:M-1];

    // ========================================================================
    // Shared PE Pool
    // ========================================================================
    // Multipliers
    reg [31:0] mul_a [0:NUM_MUL-1];
    reg [31:0] mul_b [0:NUM_MUL-1];
    reg        mul_en[0:NUM_MUL-1];
    wire[31:0] mul_z [0:NUM_MUL-1];
    wire       mul_vld[0:NUM_MUL-1];
    
    genvar gm;
    generate
        for (gm = 0; gm < NUM_MUL; gm = gm + 1) begin : MUL_PE
            PE_fp_mul u_mul (
                .clk(clk), .rstn(~rst), .in_vld(mul_en[gm]),
                .a(mul_a[gm]), .b(mul_b[gm]), 
                .out_vld(mul_vld[gm]), .z(mul_z[gm])
            );
        end
    endgenerate

    // Adders
    reg [31:0] add_a [0:NUM_ADD-1];
    reg [31:0] add_b [0:NUM_ADD-1];
    reg        add_en[0:NUM_ADD-1];
    wire[31:0] add_z [0:NUM_ADD-1];
    wire       add_vld[0:NUM_ADD-1];
    
    genvar ga;
    generate
        for (ga = 0; ga < NUM_ADD; ga = ga + 1) begin : ADD_PE
            PE_fp_add u_add (
                .clk(clk), .rstn(~rst), .in_vld(add_en[ga]),
                .a(add_a[ga]), .b(add_b[ga]), 
                .out_vld(add_vld[ga]), .z(add_z[ga])
            );
        end
    endgenerate

    // Subtractors
    reg [31:0] sub_a [0:NUM_SUB-1];
    reg [31:0] sub_b [0:NUM_SUB-1];
    reg        sub_en[0:NUM_SUB-1];
    wire[31:0] sub_z [0:NUM_SUB-1];
    wire       sub_vld[0:NUM_SUB-1];
    
    genvar gs;
    generate
        for (gs = 0; gs < NUM_SUB; gs = gs + 1) begin : SUB_PE
            PE_fp_sub u_sub (
                .clk(clk), .rstn(~rst), .in_vld(sub_en[gs]),
                .a(sub_a[gs]), .b(sub_b[gs]), 
                .out_vld(sub_vld[gs]), .z(sub_z[gs])
            );
        end
    endgenerate

    // Special functions
    reg [31:0] sqrt_in;
    reg        sqrt_en;
    wire[31:0] sqrt_out;
    wire       sqrt_vld;
    
    PE_fp_sqrt u_sqrt (
        .clk(clk), .rstn(~rst), .in_vld(sqrt_en),
        .a(sqrt_in), .out_vld(sqrt_vld), .z(sqrt_out)
    );

    reg [31:0] div_num, div_den;
    reg        div_en;
    wire[31:0] div_quot;
    wire       div_vld;
    
    PE_fp_div u_div (
        .clk(clk), .rstn(~rst), .in_vld(div_en),
        .a(div_num), .b(div_den), 
        .out_vld(div_vld), .z(div_quot)
    );

    reg [31:0] atan_y, atan_x;
    reg        atan_en;
    wire[31:0] atan_theta;
    wire       atan_vld;
    
    Atan2Cordic u_atan (
        .clk(clk), .rstn(~rst), .in_vld(atan_en),
        .y(atan_y), .x(atan_x), 
        .out_vld(atan_vld), .theta(atan_theta)
    );

    // Skew matrix generator
    reg [31:0] skew_x, skew_y, skew_z;
    wire[31:0] skew_K [0:2][0:2];
    
    Skew u_skew (
        .x(skew_x), .y(skew_y), .z(skew_z), .K(skew_K)
    );

    // ========================================================================
    // Constants
    // ========================================================================
    localparam [31:0] FP_ZERO    = 32'h00000000;
    localparam [31:0] FP_ONE     = 32'h3f800000;
    localparam [31:0] FP_NEG_ONE = 32'hbf800000;
    localparam [31:0] FP_HALF    = 32'h3f000000;
    localparam [31:0] FP_TWO     = 32'h40000000;

    // Negate floating point
    function automatic [31:0] negf(input [31:0] a);
        negf = {~a[31], a[30:0]};
    endfunction

    // ========================================================================
    // FSM States
    // ========================================================================
    localparam [4:0] ST_IDLE         = 5'd0,
                     // Camera states
                     ST_CAM_PROJ     = 5'd1,
                     ST_CAM_JAC_LM   = 5'd2,
                     ST_CAM_JAC_POSE = 5'd3,
                     ST_CAM_WRITE    = 5'd4,
                     // IMU states
                     ST_IMU_V        = 5'd5,
                     ST_IMU_RT       = 5'd6,
                     ST_IMU_C        = 5'd7,
                     ST_IMU_RE       = 5'd8,
                     ST_IMU_LOG      = 5'd9,
                     ST_IMU_JAC_M    = 5'd10,
                     ST_IMU_JAC_K    = 5'd11,
                     ST_IMU_WRITE    = 5'd12,
                     // Prior states
                     ST_PRI_C        = 5'd13,
                     ST_PRI_LOG      = 5'd14,
                     ST_PRI_T        = 5'd15,
                     ST_PRI_WRITE    = 5'd16;

    reg [4:0]  fact_state;
    reg [7:0]  fact_step;

    // Intermediate storage
    reg [31:0] temp_reg [0:127];
    reg [31:0] jacobian [0:5][0:11]; // Max 6 rows x 12 cols (pose0(6) + pose1(6) or lm(3)+pose(6))
    reg [31:0] residual [0:5];

    // ========================================================================
    // Factor Processing FSM
    // ========================================================================
    integer i, j;

    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst) begin
            fact_state <= ST_IDLE;
            factor_ready <= 1'b1;
            fact_step <= 8'd0;
            
            // Clear PE enables
            for (i = 0; i < NUM_MUL; i = i + 1) mul_en[i] <= 1'b0;
            for (i = 0; i < NUM_ADD; i = i + 1) add_en[i] <= 1'b0;
            for (i = 0; i < NUM_SUB; i = i + 1) sub_en[i] <= 1'b0;
            sqrt_en <= 1'b0;
            div_en <= 1'b0;
            atan_en <= 1'b0;
            
        end else begin
            // Default: disable all PE each cycle (re-enable as needed)
            for (i = 0; i < NUM_MUL; i = i + 1) mul_en[i] <= 1'b0;
            for (i = 0; i < NUM_ADD; i = i + 1) add_en[i] <= 1'b0;
            for (i = 0; i < NUM_SUB; i = i + 1) sub_en[i] <= 1'b0;
            sqrt_en <= 1'b0;
            div_en <= 1'b0;
            atan_en <= 1'b0;

            case (fact_state)
                
                // ============================================================
                // IDLE: Wait for factor input
                // ============================================================
                ST_IDLE: begin
                    if (factor_valid && factor_ready) begin
                        factor_ready <= 1'b0;
                        fact_step <= 8'd0;
                        
                        case (factor_type)
                            2'd0: fact_state <= ST_CAM_PROJ;
                            2'd1: fact_state <= ST_IMU_V;
                            2'd2: fact_state <= ST_PRI_C;
                            default: begin
                                fact_state <= ST_IDLE;
                                factor_ready <= 1'b1;
                            end
                        endcase
                    end
                end

                // ============================================================
                // CAMERA FACTOR
                // ============================================================
                
                // Projection & Residual Computation
                ST_CAM_PROJ: begin
                    case (fact_step)
                        8'd0: begin
                            // Launch: fx*invZ, fy*invZ, X*invZ, Y*invZ, invZ^2
                            mul_a[0] <= cam_fx;   mul_b[0] <= cam_Pc_invZ; mul_en[0] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[1] <= cam_fy;   mul_b[1] <= cam_Pc_invZ; mul_en[1] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[2] <= cam_Pc_X; mul_b[2] <= cam_Pc_invZ; mul_en[2] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[3] <= cam_Pc_Y; mul_b[3] <= cam_Pc_invZ; mul_en[3] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[4] <= cam_Pc_invZ; mul_b[4] <= cam_Pc_invZ; mul_en[4] <= 1'b1;
                            fact_step <= 8'd1;
                        end
                        8'd1: begin
                            if (mul_vld[0]) begin
                                temp_reg[0] <= mul_z[0]; // fx/Z
                                temp_reg[1] <= mul_z[1]; // fy/Z
                                temp_reg[2] <= mul_z[2]; // X/Z
                                temp_reg[3] <= mul_z[3]; // Y/Z
                                temp_reg[4] <= mul_z[4]; // invZ^2
                                fact_step <= 8'd2;
                            end
                        end
                        8'd2: begin
                            // fx*X/Z, fy*Y/Z, fx*X, fy*Y
                            mul_a[0] <= cam_fx; mul_b[0] <= temp_reg[2]; mul_en[0] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[1] <= cam_fy; mul_b[1] <= temp_reg[3]; mul_en[1] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[2] <= cam_fx; mul_b[2] <= cam_Pc_X;    mul_en[2] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[3] <= cam_fy; mul_b[3] <= cam_Pc_Y;    mul_en[3] <= 1'b1;
                            fact_step <= 8'd3;
                        end
                        8'd3: begin
                            if (mul_vld[0]) begin
                                temp_reg[5] <= mul_z[0]; // fx*X/Z
                                temp_reg[6] <= mul_z[1]; // fy*Y/Z
                                temp_reg[7] <= mul_z[2]; // fx*X
                                temp_reg[8] <= mul_z[3]; // fy*Y
                                fact_step <= 8'd4;
                            end
                        end
                        8'd4: begin
                            // u_pred = fx*X/Z + cx; v_pred = fy*Y/Z + cy
                            add_a[0] <= temp_reg[5]; add_b[0] <= cam_cx; add_en[0] <= 1'b1;
                            add_a[1] <= temp_reg[6]; add_b[1] <= cam_cy; add_en[1] <= 1'b1;
                            // a13 = -fx*X*invZ^2; a23 = -fy*Y*invZ^2
                            mul_a[2] <= temp_reg[7]; mul_b[2] <= temp_reg[4]; mul_en[2] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[3] <= temp_reg[8]; mul_b[3] <= temp_reg[4]; mul_en[3] <= 1'b1;
                            fact_step <= 8'd5;
                        end
                        8'd5: begin
                            if (add_vld[0] && mul_vld[2]) begin
                                temp_reg[9]  <= add_z[0];        // u_pred
                                temp_reg[10] <= add_z[1];        // v_pred
                                temp_reg[11] <= negf(mul_z[2]); // a13
                                temp_reg[12] <= negf(mul_z[3]); // a23
                                fact_step <= 8'd6;
                            end
                        end
                        8'd6: begin
                            // Residual r = z - pred
                            sub_a[0] <= cam_z_u; sub_b[0] <= temp_reg[9];  sub_en[0] <= 1'b1;
                            sub_a[1] <= cam_z_v; sub_b[1] <= temp_reg[10]; sub_en[1] <= 1'b1;
                            // Setup skew(Pc)
                            skew_x <= cam_Pc_X;
                            skew_y <= cam_Pc_Y;
                            skew_z <= cam_Pc_Z;
                            fact_step <= 8'd7;
                        end
                        8'd7: begin
                            if (sub_vld[0]) begin
                                residual[0] <= sub_z[0]; // r_u
                                residual[1] <= sub_z[1]; // r_v
                                fact_state <= ST_CAM_JAC_LM;
                                fact_step <= 8'd0;
                            end
                        end
                        default: fact_step <= 8'd0;
                    endcase
                end

                // Jacobian wrt Landmark
                ST_CAM_JAC_LM: begin
                    case (fact_step)
                        8'd0: begin
                            // Jl row0 = [a11,0,a13]*R = fx/Z*R[0,:] + a13*R[2,:]
                            mul_a[0] <= temp_reg[0]; mul_b[0] <= cam_Rcw[0][0]; mul_en[0] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[1] <= temp_reg[0]; mul_b[1] <= cam_Rcw[0][1]; mul_en[1] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[2] <= temp_reg[0]; mul_b[2] <= cam_Rcw[0][2]; mul_en[2] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[3] <= temp_reg[11]; mul_b[3] <= cam_Rcw[2][0]; mul_en[3] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[4] <= temp_reg[11]; mul_b[4] <= cam_Rcw[2][1]; mul_en[4] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[5] <= temp_reg[11]; mul_b[5] <= cam_Rcw[2][2]; mul_en[5] <= 1'b1;
                            fact_step <= 8'd1;
                        end
                        8'd1: begin
                            if (mul_vld[0]) begin
                                temp_reg[20] <= mul_z[0]; temp_reg[21] <= mul_z[1]; temp_reg[22] <= mul_z[2];
                                temp_reg[23] <= mul_z[3]; temp_reg[24] <= mul_z[4]; temp_reg[25] <= mul_z[5];
                                fact_step <= 8'd2;
                            end
                        end
                        8'd2: begin
                            add_a[0] <= temp_reg[20]; add_b[0] <= temp_reg[23]; add_en[0] <= 1'b1;
                            add_a[1] <= temp_reg[21]; add_b[1] <= temp_reg[24]; add_en[1] <= 1'b1;
                            add_a[2] <= temp_reg[22]; add_b[2] <= temp_reg[25]; add_en[2] <= 1'b1;
                            // Jl row1 = [0,a22,a23]*R = fy/Z*R[1,:] + a23*R[2,:]
                            mul_a[6] <= temp_reg[1]; mul_b[6] <= cam_Rcw[1][0]; mul_en[6] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[7] <= temp_reg[1]; mul_b[7] <= cam_Rcw[1][1]; mul_en[7] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[8] <= temp_reg[1]; mul_b[8] <= cam_Rcw[1][2]; mul_en[8] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[9] <= temp_reg[12]; mul_b[9] <= cam_Rcw[2][0]; mul_en[9] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[10] <= temp_reg[12]; mul_b[10] <= cam_Rcw[2][1]; mul_en[10] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[11] <= temp_reg[12]; mul_b[11] <= cam_Rcw[2][2]; mul_en[11] <= 1'b1;
                            fact_step <= 8'd3;
                        end
                        8'd3: begin
                            if (add_vld[0] && mul_vld[6]) begin
                                jacobian[0][0] <= add_z[0]; // Jl row0
                                jacobian[0][1] <= add_z[1];
                                jacobian[0][2] <= add_z[2];
                                temp_reg[26] <= mul_z[6]; temp_reg[27] <= mul_z[7]; temp_reg[28] <= mul_z[8];
                                temp_reg[29] <= mul_z[9]; temp_reg[30] <= mul_z[10]; temp_reg[31] <= mul_z[11];
                                fact_step <= 8'd4;
                            end
                        end
                        8'd4: begin
                            add_a[0] <= temp_reg[26]; add_b[0] <= temp_reg[29]; add_en[0] <= 1'b1;
                            add_a[1] <= temp_reg[27]; add_b[1] <= temp_reg[30]; add_en[1] <= 1'b1;
                            add_a[2] <= temp_reg[28]; add_b[2] <= temp_reg[31]; add_en[2] <= 1'b1;
                            fact_step <= 8'd5;
                        end
                        8'd5: begin
                            if (add_vld[0]) begin
                                jacobian[1][0] <= add_z[0]; // Jl row1
                                jacobian[1][1] <= add_z[1];
                                jacobian[1][2] <= add_z[2];
                                fact_state <= ST_CAM_JAC_POSE;
                                fact_step <= 8'd0;
                            end
                        end
                        default: fact_step <= 8'd0;
                    endcase
                end

                // Jacobian wrt Pose
                ST_CAM_JAC_POSE: begin
                    case (fact_step)
                        8'd0: begin
                            // Translation block (direct from Jproj)
                            jacobian[0][3] <= temp_reg[0];  // a11
                            jacobian[0][4] <= FP_ZERO;
                            jacobian[0][5] <= temp_reg[11]; // a13
                            jacobian[1][3] <= FP_ZERO;
                            jacobian[1][4] <= temp_reg[1];  // a22
                            jacobian[1][5] <= temp_reg[12]; // a23
                            
                            // Rotation block: Jproj * (-[Pc]_x)
                            // Row0: [a11,0,a13] * (-skew_K)
                            mul_a[0] <= temp_reg[0]; mul_b[0] <= negf(skew_K[0][0]); mul_en[0] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[1] <= temp_reg[0]; mul_b[1] <= negf(skew_K[0][1]); mul_en[1] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[2] <= temp_reg[0]; mul_b[2] <= negf(skew_K[0][2]); mul_en[2] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[3] <= temp_reg[11]; mul_b[3] <= negf(skew_K[2][0]); mul_en[3] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[4] <= temp_reg[11]; mul_b[4] <= negf(skew_K[2][1]); mul_en[4] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[5] <= temp_reg[11]; mul_b[5] <= negf(skew_K[2][2]); mul_en[5] <= 1'b1;
                            fact_step <= 8'd1;
                        end
                        8'd1: begin
                            if (mul_vld[0]) begin
                                temp_reg[32] <= mul_z[0]; temp_reg[33] <= mul_z[1]; temp_reg[34] <= mul_z[2];
                                temp_reg[35] <= mul_z[3]; temp_reg[36] <= mul_z[4]; temp_reg[37] <= mul_z[5];
                                fact_step <= 8'd2;
                            end
                        end
                        8'd2: begin
                            add_a[0] <= temp_reg[32]; add_b[0] <= temp_reg[35]; add_en[0] <= 1'b1;
                            add_a[1] <= temp_reg[33]; add_b[1] <= temp_reg[36]; add_en[1] <= 1'b1;
                            add_a[2] <= temp_reg[34]; add_b[2] <= temp_reg[37]; add_en[2] <= 1'b1;
                            // Row1: [0,a22,a23] * (-skew_K)
                            mul_a[6] <= temp_reg[1]; mul_b[6] <= negf(skew_K[1][0]); mul_en[6] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[7] <= temp_reg[1]; mul_b[7] <= negf(skew_K[1][1]); mul_en[7] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[8] <= temp_reg[1]; mul_b[8] <= negf(skew_K[1][2]); mul_en[8] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[9] <= temp_reg[12]; mul_b[9] <= negf(skew_K[2][0]); mul_en[9] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[10] <= temp_reg[12]; mul_b[10] <= negf(skew_K[2][1]); mul_en[10] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[11] <= temp_reg[12]; mul_b[11] <= negf(skew_K[2][2]); mul_en[11] <= 1'b1;
                            fact_step <= 8'd3;
                        end
                        8'd3: begin
                            if (add_vld[0] && mul_vld[6]) begin
                                jacobian[0][6] <= add_z[0]; // Jpose row0 rot
                                jacobian[0][7] <= add_z[1];
                                jacobian[0][8] <= add_z[2];
                                temp_reg[38] <= mul_z[6]; temp_reg[39] <= mul_z[7]; temp_reg[40] <= mul_z[8];
                                temp_reg[41] <= mul_z[9]; temp_reg[42] <= mul_z[10]; temp_reg[43] <= mul_z[11];
                                fact_step <= 8'd4;
                            end
                        end
                        8'd4: begin
                            add_a[0] <= temp_reg[38]; add_b[0] <= temp_reg[41]; add_en[0] <= 1'b1;
                            add_a[1] <= temp_reg[39]; add_b[1] <= temp_reg[42]; add_en[1] <= 1'b1;
                            add_a[2] <= temp_reg[40]; add_b[2] <= temp_reg[43]; add_en[2] <= 1'b1;
                            fact_step <= 8'd5;
                        end
                        8'd5: begin
                            if (add_vld[0]) begin
                                jacobian[1][6] <= add_z[0]; // Jpose row1 rot
                                jacobian[1][7] <= add_z[1];
                                jacobian[1][8] <= add_z[2];
                                fact_state <= ST_CAM_WRITE;
                                fact_step <= 8'd0;
                            end
                        end
                        default: fact_step <= 8'd0;
                    endcase
                end

                // Write Camera rows with whitening
                ST_CAM_WRITE: begin
                    case (fact_step)
                        8'd0: begin
                            // Whiten row 0: jacobian[0][0..8] * alpha[0]
                            for (i = 0; i < 9; i = i + 1) begin
                                mul_a[i] <= jacobian[0][i]; 
                                mul_b[i] <= alpha[0]; 
                                mul_en[i] <= 1'b1;
                            end
                            mul_a[9] <= residual[0]; mul_b[9] <= alpha[0]; mul_en[9] <= 1'b1;
                            fact_step <= 8'd1;
                        end
                        8'd1: begin
                            if (mul_vld[0]) begin
                                // Write row 0: landmark block (3 cols) + pose block (6 cols)
                                matrix_buf[factor_row_base][col_var1+0] <= mul_z[0];
                                matrix_buf[factor_row_base][col_var1+1] <= mul_z[1];
                                matrix_buf[factor_row_base][col_var1+2] <= mul_z[2];
                                matrix_buf[factor_row_base][col_var0+0] <= mul_z[3];
                                matrix_buf[factor_row_base][col_var0+1] <= mul_z[4];
                                matrix_buf[factor_row_base][col_var0+2] <= mul_z[5];
                                matrix_buf[factor_row_base][col_var0+3] <= mul_z[6];
                                matrix_buf[factor_row_base][col_var0+4] <= mul_z[7];
                                matrix_buf[factor_row_base][col_var0+5] <= mul_z[8];
                                b_buf[factor_row_base] <= mul_z[9];
                                fact_step <= 8'd2;
                            end
                        end
                        8'd2: begin
                            // Whiten row 1
                            for (i = 0; i < 9; i = i + 1) begin
                                mul_a[i] <= jacobian[1][i]; 
                                mul_b[i] <= alpha[1]; 
                                mul_en[i] <= 1'b1;
                            end
                            mul_a[9] <= residual[1]; mul_b[9] <= alpha[1]; mul_en[9] <= 1'b1;
                            fact_step <= 8'd3;
                        end
                        8'd3: begin
                            if (mul_vld[0]) begin
                                matrix_buf[factor_row_base+1][col_var1+0] <= mul_z[0];
                                matrix_buf[factor_row_base+1][col_var1+1] <= mul_z[1];
                                matrix_buf[factor_row_base+1][col_var1+2] <= mul_z[2];
                                matrix_buf[factor_row_base+1][col_var0+0] <= mul_z[3];
                                matrix_buf[factor_row_base+1][col_var0+1] <= mul_z[4];
                                matrix_buf[factor_row_base+1][col_var0+2] <= mul_z[5];
                                matrix_buf[factor_row_base+1][col_var0+3] <= mul_z[6];
                                matrix_buf[factor_row_base+1][col_var0+4] <= mul_z[7];
                                matrix_buf[factor_row_base+1][col_var0+5] <= mul_z[8];
                                b_buf[factor_row_base+1] <= mul_z[9];
                                
                                fact_state <= ST_IDLE;
                                factor_ready <= 1'b1;
                                fact_step <= 8'd0;
                            end
                        end
                        default: fact_step <= 8'd0;
                    endcase
                end

                // ============================================================
                // IMU FACTOR
                // ============================================================
                
                // Compute vi = Ri^T * (tj - ti)
                ST_IMU_V: begin
                    case (fact_step)
                        8'd0: begin
                            sub_a[0] <= t1[0]; sub_b[0] <= t0[0]; sub_en[0] <= 1'b1;
                            sub_a[1] <= t1[1]; sub_b[1] <= t0[1]; sub_en[1] <= 1'b1;
                            sub_a[2] <= t1[2]; sub_b[2] <= t0[2]; sub_en[2] <= 1'b1;
                            fact_step <= 8'd1;
                        end
                        8'd1: begin
                            if (sub_vld[0]) begin
                                temp_reg[0] <= sub_z[0]; // v[0] = tj-ti
                                temp_reg[1] <= sub_z[1];
                                temp_reg[2] <= sub_z[2];
                                fact_step <= 8'd2;
                            end
                        end
                        8'd2: begin
                            // vi[0] = R0^T * v (row 0 of R0^T = col 0 of R0)
                            mul_a[0] <= R0[0][0]; mul_b[0] <= temp_reg[0]; mul_en[0] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[1] <= R0[1][0]; mul_b[1] <= temp_reg[1]; mul_en[1] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[2] <= R0[2][0]; mul_b[2] <= temp_reg[2]; mul_en[2] <= 1'b1;
                            // vi[1]
                            mul_a[3] <= R0[0][1]; mul_b[3] <= temp_reg[0]; mul_en[3] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[4] <= R0[1][1]; mul_b[4] <= temp_reg[1]; mul_en[4] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[5] <= R0[2][1]; mul_b[5] <= temp_reg[2]; mul_en[5] <= 1'b1;
                            // vi[2]
                            mul_a[6] <= R0[0][2]; mul_b[6] <= temp_reg[0]; mul_en[6] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[7] <= R0[1][2]; mul_b[7] <= temp_reg[1]; mul_en[7] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[8] <= R0[2][2]; mul_b[8] <= temp_reg[2]; mul_en[8] <= 1'b1;
                            fact_step <= 8'd3;
                        end
                        8'd3: begin
                            if (mul_vld[0]) begin
                                temp_reg[3] <= mul_z[0]; temp_reg[4] <= mul_z[1]; temp_reg[5] <= mul_z[2];
                                temp_reg[6] <= mul_z[3]; temp_reg[7] <= mul_z[4]; temp_reg[8] <= mul_z[5];
                                temp_reg[9] <= mul_z[6]; temp_reg[10] <= mul_z[7]; temp_reg[11] <= mul_z[8];
                                fact_step <= 8'd4;
                            end
                        end
                        8'd4: begin
                            add_a[0] <= temp_reg[3]; add_b[0] <= temp_reg[4]; add_en[0] <= 1'b1;
                            add_a[1] <= temp_reg[6]; add_b[1] <= temp_reg[7]; add_en[1] <= 1'b1;
                            add_a[2] <= temp_reg[9]; add_b[2] <= temp_reg[10]; add_en[2] <= 1'b1;
                            fact_step <= 8'd5;
                        end
                        8'd5: begin
                            if (add_vld[0]) begin
                                temp_reg[12] <= add_z[0]; // partial sum
                                temp_reg[13] <= add_z[1];
                                temp_reg[14] <= add_z[2];
                                fact_step <= 8'd6;
                            end
                        end
                        8'd6: begin
                            add_a[0] <= temp_reg[12]; add_b[0] <= temp_reg[5]; add_en[0] <= 1'b1;
                            add_a[1] <= temp_reg[13]; add_b[1] <= temp_reg[8]; add_en[1] <= 1'b1;
                            add_a[2] <= temp_reg[14]; add_b[2] <= temp_reg[11]; add_en[2] <= 1'b1;
                            fact_step <= 8'd7;
                        end
                        8'd7: begin
                            if (add_vld[0]) begin
                                temp_reg[15] <= add_z[0]; // vi[0]
                                temp_reg[16] <= add_z[1]; // vi[1]
                                temp_reg[17] <= add_z[2]; // vi[2]
                                // Setup skew(vi) for later
                                skew_x <= add_z[0];
                                skew_y <= add_z[1];
                                skew_z <= add_z[2];
                                fact_state <= ST_IMU_RT;
                                fact_step <= 8'd0;
                            end
                        end
                        default: fact_step <= 8'd0;
                    endcase
                end

                // Compute translation residual rt = Rd^T * (vi - td)
                ST_IMU_RT: begin
                    case (fact_step)
                        8'd0: begin
                            sub_a[0] <= temp_reg[15]; sub_b[0] <= td[0]; sub_en[0] <= 1'b1;
                            sub_a[1] <= temp_reg[16]; sub_b[1] <= td[1]; sub_en[1] <= 1'b1;
                            sub_a[2] <= temp_reg[17]; sub_b[2] <= td[2]; sub_en[2] <= 1'b1;
                            fact_step <= 8'd1;
                        end
                        8'd1: begin
                            if (sub_vld[0]) begin
                                temp_reg[18] <= sub_z[0]; // vtilde
                                temp_reg[19] <= sub_z[1];
                                temp_reg[20] <= sub_z[2];
                                fact_step <= 8'd2;
                            end
                        end
                        8'd2: begin
                            // rt = Rd^T * vtilde (3 dot products)
                            mul_a[0] <= Rd[0][0]; mul_b[0] <= temp_reg[18]; mul_en[0] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[1] <= Rd[1][0]; mul_b[1] <= temp_reg[19]; mul_en[1] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[2] <= Rd[2][0]; mul_b[2] <= temp_reg[20]; mul_en[2] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[3] <= Rd[0][1]; mul_b[3] <= temp_reg[18]; mul_en[3] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[4] <= Rd[1][1]; mul_b[4] <= temp_reg[19]; mul_en[4] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[5] <= Rd[2][1]; mul_b[5] <= temp_reg[20]; mul_en[5] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[6] <= Rd[0][2]; mul_b[6] <= temp_reg[18]; mul_en[6] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[7] <= Rd[1][2]; mul_b[7] <= temp_reg[19]; mul_en[7] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[8] <= Rd[2][2]; mul_b[8] <= temp_reg[20]; mul_en[8] <= 1'b1;
                            fact_step <= 8'd3;
                        end
                        8'd3: begin
                            if (mul_vld[0]) begin
                                temp_reg[21] <= mul_z[0]; temp_reg[22] <= mul_z[1]; temp_reg[23] <= mul_z[2];
                                temp_reg[24] <= mul_z[3]; temp_reg[25] <= mul_z[4]; temp_reg[26] <= mul_z[5];
                                temp_reg[27] <= mul_z[6]; temp_reg[28] <= mul_z[7]; temp_reg[29] <= mul_z[8];
                                fact_step <= 8'd4;
                            end
                        end
                        8'd4: begin
                            add_a[0] <= temp_reg[21]; add_b[0] <= temp_reg[22]; add_en[0] <= 1'b1;
                            add_a[1] <= temp_reg[24]; add_b[1] <= temp_reg[25]; add_en[1] <= 1'b1;
                            add_a[2] <= temp_reg[27]; add_b[2] <= temp_reg[28]; add_en[2] <= 1'b1;
                            fact_step <= 8'd5;
                        end
                        8'd5: begin
                            if (add_vld[0]) begin
                                temp_reg[30] <= add_z[0]; // rt partial
                                temp_reg[31] <= add_z[1];
                                temp_reg[32] <= add_z[2];
                                fact_step <= 8'd6;
                            end
                        end
                        8'd6: begin
                            add_a[0] <= temp_reg[30]; add_b[0] <= temp_reg[23]; add_en[0] <= 1'b1;
                            add_a[1] <= temp_reg[31]; add_b[1] <= temp_reg[26]; add_en[1] <= 1'b1;
                            add_a[2] <= temp_reg[32]; add_b[2] <= temp_reg[29]; add_en[2] <= 1'b1;
                            fact_step <= 8'd7;
                        end
                        8'd7: begin
                            if (add_vld[0]) begin
                                residual[0] <= add_z[0]; // rt[0]
                                residual[1] <= add_z[1]; // rt[1]
                                residual[2] <= add_z[2]; // rt[2]
                                fact_state <= ST_IMU_C;
                                fact_step <= 8'd0;
                            end
                        end
                        default: fact_step <= 8'd0;
                    endcase
                end

                // Compute C = Ri^T * Rj (3x3 matrix)
                ST_IMU_C: begin
                    case (fact_step)
                        8'd0: begin
                            // C[0][0..2]: row0 of R0^T times cols of R1
                            mul_a[0] <= R0[0][0]; mul_b[0] <= R1[0][0]; mul_en[0] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[1] <= R0[1][0]; mul_b[1] <= R1[1][0]; mul_en[1] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[2] <= R0[2][0]; mul_b[2] <= R1[2][0]; mul_en[2] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[3] <= R0[0][0]; mul_b[3] <= R1[0][1]; mul_en[3] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[4] <= R0[1][0]; mul_b[4] <= R1[1][1]; mul_en[4] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[5] <= R0[2][0]; mul_b[5] <= R1[2][1]; mul_en[5] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[6] <= R0[0][0]; mul_b[6] <= R1[0][2]; mul_en[6] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[7] <= R0[1][0]; mul_b[7] <= R1[1][2]; mul_en[7] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[8] <= R0[2][0]; mul_b[8] <= R1[2][2]; mul_en[8] <= 1'b1;
                            fact_step <= 8'd1;
                        end
                        8'd1: begin
                            if (mul_vld[0]) begin
                                temp_reg[40] <= mul_z[0]; temp_reg[41] <= mul_z[1]; temp_reg[42] <= mul_z[2];
                                temp_reg[43] <= mul_z[3]; temp_reg[44] <= mul_z[4]; temp_reg[45] <= mul_z[5];
                                temp_reg[46] <= mul_z[6]; temp_reg[47] <= mul_z[7]; temp_reg[48] <= mul_z[8];
                                fact_step <= 8'd2;
                            end
                        end
                        8'd2: begin
                            // Sum to get C row0
                            add_a[0] <= temp_reg[40]; add_b[0] <= temp_reg[41]; add_en[0] <= 1'b1;
                            add_a[1] <= temp_reg[43]; add_b[1] <= temp_reg[44]; add_en[1] <= 1'b1;
                            add_a[2] <= temp_reg[46]; add_b[2] <= temp_reg[47]; add_en[2] <= 1'b1;
                            // C row1
                            mul_a[9] <= R0[0][1]; mul_b[9] <= R1[0][0]; mul_en[9] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[10] <= R0[1][1]; mul_b[10] <= R1[1][0]; mul_en[10] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[11] <= R0[2][1]; mul_b[11] <= R1[2][0]; mul_en[11] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[12] <= R0[0][1]; mul_b[12] <= R1[0][1]; mul_en[12] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[13] <= R0[1][1]; mul_b[13] <= R1[1][1]; mul_en[13] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[14] <= R0[2][1]; mul_b[14] <= R1[2][1]; mul_en[14] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[15] <= R0[0][1]; mul_b[15] <= R1[0][2]; mul_en[15] <= 1'b1;
                            fact_step <= 8'd3;
                        end
                        8'd3: begin
                            if (add_vld[0] && mul_vld[9]) begin
                                temp_reg[49] <= add_z[0]; temp_reg[50] <= temp_reg[42];
                                temp_reg[51] <= add_z[1]; temp_reg[52] <= temp_reg[45];
                                temp_reg[53] <= add_z[2]; temp_reg[54] <= temp_reg[48];
                                temp_reg[55] <= mul_z[9]; temp_reg[56] <= mul_z[10]; temp_reg[57] <= mul_z[11];
                                temp_reg[58] <= mul_z[12]; temp_reg[59] <= mul_z[13]; temp_reg[60] <= mul_z[14];
                                temp_reg[61] <= mul_z[15];
                                fact_step <= 8'd4;
                            end
                        end
                        8'd4: begin
                            add_a[0] <= temp_reg[49]; add_b[0] <= temp_reg[50]; add_en[0] <= 1'b1; // C[0][0]
                            add_a[1] <= temp_reg[51]; add_b[1] <= temp_reg[52]; add_en[1] <= 1'b1; // C[0][1]
                            add_a[2] <= temp_reg[53]; add_b[2] <= temp_reg[54]; add_en[2] <= 1'b1; // C[0][2]
                            add_a[3] <= temp_reg[55]; add_b[3] <= temp_reg[56]; add_en[3] <= 1'b1; // C[1][0] partial
                            add_a[4] <= temp_reg[58]; add_b[4] <= temp_reg[59]; add_en[4] <= 1'b1; // C[1][1] partial
                            // C row1 col2 and row2
                            mul_a[0] <= R0[1][1]; mul_b[0] <= R1[1][2]; mul_en[0] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[1] <= R0[2][1]; mul_b[1] <= R1[2][2]; mul_en[1] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[2] <= R0[0][2]; mul_b[2] <= R1[0][0]; mul_en[2] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[3] <= R0[1][2]; mul_b[3] <= R1[1][0]; mul_en[3] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[4] <= R0[2][2]; mul_b[4] <= R1[2][0]; mul_en[4] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[5] <= R0[0][2]; mul_b[5] <= R1[0][1]; mul_en[5] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[6] <= R0[1][2]; mul_b[6] <= R1[1][1]; mul_en[6] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[7] <= R0[2][2]; mul_b[7] <= R1[2][1]; mul_en[7] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[8] <= R0[0][2]; mul_b[8] <= R1[0][2]; mul_en[8] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[9] <= R0[1][2]; mul_b[9] <= R1[1][2]; mul_en[9] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[10] <= R0[2][2]; mul_b[10] <= R1[2][2]; mul_en[10] <= 1'b1;
                            fact_step <= 8'd5;
                        end
                        8'd5: begin
                            if (add_vld[0] && mul_vld[0]) begin
                                temp_reg[62] <= add_z[0]; // C[0][0]
                                temp_reg[63] <= add_z[1]; // C[0][1]
                                temp_reg[64] <= add_z[2]; // C[0][2]
                                temp_reg[65] <= add_z[3]; temp_reg[66] <= temp_reg[57];
                                temp_reg[67] <= add_z[4]; temp_reg[68] <= temp_reg[60];
                                temp_reg[69] <= mul_z[0]; temp_reg[70] <= mul_z[1];
                                temp_reg[71] <= mul_z[2]; temp_reg[72] <= mul_z[3]; temp_reg[73] <= mul_z[4];
                                temp_reg[74] <= mul_z[5]; temp_reg[75] <= mul_z[6]; temp_reg[76] <= mul_z[7];
                                temp_reg[77] <= mul_z[8]; temp_reg[78] <= mul_z[9]; temp_reg[79] <= mul_z[10];
                                fact_step <= 8'd6;
                            end
                        end
                        8'd6: begin
                            add_a[0] <= temp_reg[65]; add_b[0] <= temp_reg[66]; add_en[0] <= 1'b1; // C[1][0]
                            add_a[1] <= temp_reg[67]; add_b[1] <= temp_reg[68]; add_en[1] <= 1'b1; // C[1][1]
                            add_a[2] <= temp_reg[69]; add_b[2] <= temp_reg[70]; add_en[2] <= 1'b1; // C[1][2] partial
                            add_a[3] <= temp_reg[71]; add_b[3] <= temp_reg[72]; add_en[3] <= 1'b1; // C[2][0] partial
                            add_a[4] <= temp_reg[74]; add_b[4] <= temp_reg[75]; add_en[4] <= 1'b1; // C[2][1] partial
                            add_a[5] <= temp_reg[77]; add_b[5] <= temp_reg[78]; add_en[5] <= 1'b1; // C[2][2] partial
                            fact_step <= 8'd7;
                        end
                        8'd7: begin
                            if (add_vld[0]) begin
                                temp_reg[80] <= add_z[0]; // C[1][0]
                                temp_reg[81] <= add_z[1]; // C[1][1]
                                temp_reg[82] <= add_z[2]; temp_reg[83] <= temp_reg[61];
                                temp_reg[84] <= add_z[3]; temp_reg[85] <= temp_reg[73];
                                temp_reg[86] <= add_z[4]; temp_reg[87] <= temp_reg[76];
                                temp_reg[88] <= add_z[5]; temp_reg[89] <= temp_reg[79];
                                fact_step <= 8'd8;
                            end
                        end
                        8'd8: begin
                            add_a[0] <= temp_reg[82]; add_b[0] <= temp_reg[83]; add_en[0] <= 1'b1; // C[1][2]
                            add_a[1] <= temp_reg[84]; add_b[1] <= temp_reg[85]; add_en[1] <= 1'b1; // C[2][0]
                            add_a[2] <= temp_reg[86]; add_b[2] <= temp_reg[87]; add_en[2] <= 1'b1; // C[2][1]
                            add_a[3] <= temp_reg[88]; add_b[3] <= temp_reg[89]; add_en[3] <= 1'b1; // C[2][2]
                            fact_step <= 8'd9;
                        end
                        8'd9: begin
                            if (add_vld[0]) begin
                                temp_reg[90] <= temp_reg[62]; // C[0][0]
                                temp_reg[91] <= temp_reg[63]; // C[0][1]
                                temp_reg[92] <= temp_reg[64]; // C[0][2]
                                temp_reg[93] <= temp_reg[80]; // C[1][0]
                                temp_reg[94] <= temp_reg[81]; // C[1][1]
                                temp_reg[95] <= add_z[0];     // C[1][2]
                                temp_reg[96] <= add_z[1];     // C[2][0]
                                temp_reg[97] <= add_z[2];     // C[2][1]
                                temp_reg[98] <= add_z[3];     // C[2][2]
                                fact_state <= ST_IMU_RE;
                                fact_step <= 8'd0;
                            end
                        end
                        default: fact_step <= 8'd0;
                    endcase
                end

                // Compute Re = Rd^T * C (3x3 matrix multiply)
                ST_IMU_RE: begin
                    case (fact_step)
                        8'd0: begin
                            // Re[0][0..2]
                            mul_a[0] <= Rd[0][0]; mul_b[0] <= temp_reg[90]; mul_en[0] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[1] <= Rd[1][0]; mul_b[1] <= temp_reg[93]; mul_en[1] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[2] <= Rd[2][0]; mul_b[2] <= temp_reg[96]; mul_en[2] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[3] <= Rd[0][0]; mul_b[3] <= temp_reg[91]; mul_en[3] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[4] <= Rd[1][0]; mul_b[4] <= temp_reg[94]; mul_en[4] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[5] <= Rd[2][0]; mul_b[5] <= temp_reg[97]; mul_en[5] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[6] <= Rd[0][0]; mul_b[6] <= temp_reg[92]; mul_en[6] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[7] <= Rd[1][0]; mul_b[7] <= temp_reg[95]; mul_en[7] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[8] <= Rd[2][0]; mul_b[8] <= temp_reg[98]; mul_en[8] <= 1'b1;
                            fact_step <= 8'd1;
                        end
                        8'd1: begin
                            if (mul_vld[0]) begin
                                temp_reg[100] <= mul_z[0]; temp_reg[101] <= mul_z[1]; temp_reg[102] <= mul_z[2];
                                temp_reg[103] <= mul_z[3]; temp_reg[104] <= mul_z[4]; temp_reg[105] <= mul_z[5];
                                temp_reg[106] <= mul_z[6]; temp_reg[107] <= mul_z[7]; temp_reg[108] <= mul_z[8];
                                fact_step <= 8'd2;
                            end
                        end
                        8'd2: begin
                            add_a[0] <= temp_reg[100]; add_b[0] <= temp_reg[101]; add_en[0] <= 1'b1;
                            add_a[1] <= temp_reg[103]; add_b[1] <= temp_reg[104]; add_en[1] <= 1'b1;
                            add_a[2] <= temp_reg[106]; add_b[2] <= temp_reg[107]; add_en[2] <= 1'b1;
                            // Re row1,2
                            mul_a[3] <= Rd[0][1]; mul_b[3] <= temp_reg[90]; mul_en[3] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[4] <= Rd[1][1]; mul_b[4] <= temp_reg[93]; mul_en[4] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[5] <= Rd[2][1]; mul_b[5] <= temp_reg[96]; mul_en[5] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[6] <= Rd[0][1]; mul_b[6] <= temp_reg[91]; mul_en[6] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[7] <= Rd[1][1]; mul_b[7] <= temp_reg[94]; mul_en[7] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[8] <= Rd[2][1]; mul_b[8] <= temp_reg[97]; mul_en[8] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[9] <= Rd[0][1]; mul_b[9] <= temp_reg[92]; mul_en[9] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[10] <= Rd[1][1]; mul_b[10] <= temp_reg[95]; mul_en[10] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[11] <= Rd[2][1]; mul_b[11] <= temp_reg[98]; mul_en[11] <= 1'b1;
                            fact_step <= 8'd3;
                        end
                        8'd3: begin
                            if (add_vld[0] && mul_vld[3]) begin
                                temp_reg[109] <= add_z[0]; temp_reg[110] <= temp_reg[102];
                                temp_reg[111] <= add_z[1]; temp_reg[112] <= temp_reg[105];
                                temp_reg[113] <= add_z[2]; temp_reg[114] <= temp_reg[108];
                                temp_reg[115] <= mul_z[3]; temp_reg[116] <= mul_z[4]; temp_reg[117] <= mul_z[5];
                                temp_reg[118] <= mul_z[6]; temp_reg[119] <= mul_z[7]; temp_reg[120] <= mul_z[8];
                                temp_reg[121] <= mul_z[9]; temp_reg[122] <= mul_z[10]; temp_reg[123] <= mul_z[11];
                                fact_step <= 8'd4;
                            end
                        end
                        8'd4: begin
                            add_a[0] <= temp_reg[109]; add_b[0] <= temp_reg[110]; add_en[0] <= 1'b1; // Re[0][0]
                            add_a[1] <= temp_reg[111]; add_b[1] <= temp_reg[112]; add_en[1] <= 1'b1; // Re[0][1]
                            add_a[2] <= temp_reg[113]; add_b[2] <= temp_reg[114]; add_en[2] <= 1'b1; // Re[0][2]
                            add_a[3] <= temp_reg[115]; add_b[3] <= temp_reg[116]; add_en[3] <= 1'b1; // Re[1][0] p
                            add_a[4] <= temp_reg[118]; add_b[4] <= temp_reg[119]; add_en[4] <= 1'b1; // Re[1][1] p
                            add_a[5] <= temp_reg[121]; add_b[5] <= temp_reg[122]; add_en[5] <= 1'b1; // Re[1][2] p
                            // Re row2
                            mul_a[6] <= Rd[0][2]; mul_b[6] <= temp_reg[90]; mul_en[6] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[7] <= Rd[1][2]; mul_b[7] <= temp_reg[93]; mul_en[7] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[8] <= Rd[2][2]; mul_b[8] <= temp_reg[96]; mul_en[8] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[9] <= Rd[0][2]; mul_b[9] <= temp_reg[91]; mul_en[9] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[10] <= Rd[1][2]; mul_b[10] <= temp_reg[94]; mul_en[10] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[11] <= Rd[2][2]; mul_b[11] <= temp_reg[97]; mul_en[11] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[12] <= Rd[0][2]; mul_b[12] <= temp_reg[92]; mul_en[12] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[13] <= Rd[1][2]; mul_b[13] <= temp_reg[95]; mul_en[13] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[14] <= Rd[2][2]; mul_b[14] <= temp_reg[98]; mul_en[14] <= 1'b1;
                            fact_step <= 8'd5;
                        end
                        8'd5: begin
                            if (add_vld[0] && mul_vld[6]) begin
                                temp_reg[0] <= add_z[0]; // Re[0][0]
                                temp_reg[1] <= add_z[1]; // Re[0][1]
                                temp_reg[2] <= add_z[2]; // Re[0][2]
                                temp_reg[3] <= add_z[3]; temp_reg[4] <= temp_reg[117];
                                temp_reg[5] <= add_z[4]; temp_reg[6] <= temp_reg[120];
                                temp_reg[7] <= add_z[5]; temp_reg[8] <= temp_reg[123];
                                temp_reg[9] <= mul_z[6]; temp_reg[10] <= mul_z[7]; temp_reg[11] <= mul_z[8];
                                temp_reg[12] <= mul_z[9]; temp_reg[13] <= mul_z[10]; temp_reg[14] <= mul_z[11];
                                temp_reg[15] <= mul_z[12]; temp_reg[16] <= mul_z[13]; temp_reg[17] <= mul_z[14];
                                fact_step <= 8'd6;
                            end
                        end
                        8'd6: begin
                            add_a[0] <= temp_reg[3]; add_b[0] <= temp_reg[4]; add_en[0] <= 1'b1; // Re[1][0]
                            add_a[1] <= temp_reg[5]; add_b[1] <= temp_reg[6]; add_en[1] <= 1'b1; // Re[1][1]
                            add_a[2] <= temp_reg[7]; add_b[2] <= temp_reg[8]; add_en[2] <= 1'b1; // Re[1][2]
                            add_a[3] <= temp_reg[9]; add_b[3] <= temp_reg[10]; add_en[3] <= 1'b1; // Re[2][0] p
                            add_a[4] <= temp_reg[12]; add_b[4] <= temp_reg[13]; add_en[4] <= 1'b1; // Re[2][1] p
                            add_a[5] <= temp_reg[15]; add_b[5] <= temp_reg[16]; add_en[5] <= 1'b1; // Re[2][2] p
                            fact_step <= 8'd7;
                        end
                        8'd7: begin
                            if (add_vld[0]) begin
                                temp_reg[18] <= temp_reg[0]; // Re[0][0]
                                temp_reg[19] <= temp_reg[1]; // Re[0][1]
                                temp_reg[20] <= temp_reg[2]; // Re[0][2]
                                temp_reg[21] <= add_z[0];    // Re[1][0]
                                temp_reg[22] <= add_z[1];    // Re[1][1]
                                temp_reg[23] <= add_z[2];    // Re[1][2]
                                temp_reg[24] <= add_z[3]; temp_reg[25] <= temp_reg[11];
                                temp_reg[26] <= add_z[4]; temp_reg[27] <= temp_reg[14];
                                temp_reg[28] <= add_z[5]; temp_reg[29] <= temp_reg[17];
                                fact_step <= 8'd8;
                            end
                        end
                        8'd8: begin
                            add_a[0] <= temp_reg[24]; add_b[0] <= temp_reg[25]; add_en[0] <= 1'b1; // Re[2][0]
                            add_a[1] <= temp_reg[26]; add_b[1] <= temp_reg[27]; add_en[1] <= 1'b1; // Re[2][1]
                            add_a[2] <= temp_reg[28]; add_b[2] <= temp_reg[29]; add_en[2] <= 1'b1; // Re[2][2]
                            fact_step <= 8'd9;
                        end
                        8'd9: begin
                            if (add_vld[0]) begin
                                temp_reg[30] <= add_z[0]; // Re[2][0]
                                temp_reg[31] <= add_z[1]; // Re[2][1]
                                temp_reg[32] <= add_z[2]; // Re[2][2]
                                // Re matrix complete in temp_reg[18..32]
                                fact_state <= ST_IMU_LOG;
                                fact_step <= 8'd0;
                            end
                        end
                        default: fact_step <= 8'd0;
                    endcase
                end

                // Log(Re): vee(Re - Re^T)/2, then scale by theta/(2*sin(theta/2))
                ST_IMU_LOG: begin
                    case (fact_step)
                        8'd0: begin
                            // v = vee(Re - Re^T)/2 = [(Re[2][1]-Re[1][2])/2, ...]
                            sub_a[0] <= temp_reg[31]; sub_b[0] <= temp_reg[23]; sub_en[0] <= 1'b1; // Re[2][1]-Re[1][2]
                            sub_a[1] <= temp_reg[20]; sub_b[1] <= temp_reg[30]; sub_en[1] <= 1'b1; // Re[0][2]-Re[2][0]
                            sub_a[2] <= temp_reg[21]; sub_b[2] <= temp_reg[19]; sub_en[2] <= 1'b1; // Re[1][0]-Re[0][1]
                            fact_step <= 8'd1;
                        end
                        8'd1: begin
                            if (sub_vld[0]) begin
                                mul_a[0] <= sub_z[0]; mul_b[0] <= FP_HALF; mul_en[0] <= 1'b1; // vx
                                mul_a[1] <= sub_z[1]; mul_b[1] <= FP_HALF; mul_en[1] <= 1'b1; // vy
                                mul_a[2] <= sub_z[2]; mul_b[2] <= FP_HALF; mul_en[2] <= 1'b1; // vz
                                fact_step <= 8'd2;
                            end
                        end
                        8'd2: begin
                            if (mul_vld[0]) begin
                                temp_reg[33] <= mul_z[0]; // vx
                                temp_reg[34] <= mul_z[1]; // vy
                                temp_reg[35] <= mul_z[2]; // vz
                                fact_step <= 8'd3;
                            end
                        end
                        8'd3: begin
                            // cos_term = (tr(Re)-1)/2
                            add_a[0] <= temp_reg[18]; add_b[0] <= temp_reg[22]; add_en[0] <= 1'b1; // Re[0][0]+Re[1][1]
                            fact_step <= 8'd4;
                        end
                        8'd4: begin
                            if (add_vld[0]) begin
                                add_a[0] <= add_z[0]; add_b[0] <= temp_reg[32]; add_en[0] <= 1'b1; // +Re[2][2]
                                fact_step <= 8'd5;
                            end
                        end
                        8'd5: begin
                            if (add_vld[0]) begin
                                add_a[0] <= add_z[0]; add_b[0] <= FP_NEG_ONE; add_en[0] <= 1'b1; // tr-1
                                fact_step <= 8'd6;
                            end
                        end
                        8'd6: begin
                            if (add_vld[0]) begin
                                mul_a[0] <= add_z[0]; mul_b[0] <= FP_HALF; mul_en[0] <= 1'b1;
                                fact_step <= 8'd7;
                            end
                        end
                        8'd7: begin
                            if (mul_vld[0]) begin
                                temp_reg[36] <= mul_z[0]; // cos_term
                                fact_step <= 8'd8;
                            end
                        end
                        8'd8: begin
                            // sin_term = 0.5*||v||
                            mul_a[0] <= temp_reg[33]; mul_b[0] <= temp_reg[33]; mul_en[0] <= 1'b1; // vx^2
                            mul_a[1] <= temp_reg[34]; mul_b[1] <= temp_reg[34]; mul_en[1] <= 1'b1; // vy^2
                            mul_a[2] <= temp_reg[35]; mul_b[2] <= temp_reg[35]; mul_en[2] <= 1'b1; // vz^2
                            fact_step <= 8'd9;
                        end
                        8'd9: begin
                            if (mul_vld[0]) begin
                                add_a[0] <= mul_z[0]; add_b[0] <= mul_z[1]; add_en[0] <= 1'b1;
                                temp_reg[37] <= mul_z[2];
                                fact_step <= 8'd10;
                            end
                        end
                        8'd10: begin
                            if (add_vld[0]) begin
                                add_a[0] <= add_z[0]; add_b[0] <= temp_reg[37]; add_en[0] <= 1'b1;
                                fact_step <= 8'd11;
                            end
                        end
                        8'd11: begin
                            if (add_vld[0]) begin
                                sqrt_in <= add_z[0];
                                sqrt_en <= 1'b1;
                                fact_step <= 8'd12;
                            end
                        end
                        8'd12: begin
                            if (sqrt_vld) begin
                                mul_a[0] <= sqrt_out; mul_b[0] <= FP_HALF; mul_en[0] <= 1'b1;
                                fact_step <= 8'd13;
                            end
                        end
                        8'd13: begin
                            if (mul_vld[0]) begin
                                temp_reg[38] <= mul_z[0]; // sin_term
                                // atan2(sin_term, cos_term)
                                atan_y <= mul_z[0];
                                atan_x <= temp_reg[36];
                                atan_en <= 1'b1;
                                fact_step <= 8'd14;
                            end
                        end
                        8'd14: begin
                            if (atan_vld) begin
                                temp_reg[39] <= atan_theta; // theta
                                fact_step <= 8'd15;
                            end
                        end
                        8'd15: begin
                            // scale = theta / (2*sin_term)
                            mul_a[0] <= FP_TWO; mul_b[0] <= temp_reg[38]; mul_en[0] <= 1'b1;
                            fact_step <= 8'd16;
                        end
                        8'd16: begin
                            if (mul_vld[0]) begin
                                div_num <= temp_reg[39];
                                div_den <= mul_z[0];
                                div_en <= 1'b1;
                                fact_step <= 8'd17;
                            end
                        end
                        8'd17: begin
                            if (div_vld) begin
                                temp_reg[40] <= div_quot; // scale
                                fact_step <= 8'd18;
                            end
                        end
                        8'd18: begin
                            // rR = scale * v
                            mul_a[0] <= temp_reg[40]; mul_b[0] <= temp_reg[33]; mul_en[0] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[1] <= temp_reg[40]; mul_b[1] <= temp_reg[34]; mul_en[1] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[2] <= temp_reg[40]; mul_b[2] <= temp_reg[35]; mul_en[2] <= 1'b1;
                            fact_step <= 8'd19;
                        end
                        8'd19: begin
                            if (mul_vld[0]) begin
                                residual[3] <= mul_z[0]; // rR[0]
                                residual[4] <= mul_z[1]; // rR[1]
                                residual[5] <= mul_z[2]; // rR[2]
                                fact_state <= ST_IMU_JAC_M;
                                fact_step <= 8'd0;
                            end
                        end
                        default: fact_step <= 8'd0;
                    endcase
                end

                // Compute M = Rd^T * Ri^T for jacobian
                ST_IMU_JAC_M: begin
                    case (fact_step)
                        8'd0: begin
                            // M[0][0..2]
                            mul_a[0] <= Rd[0][0]; mul_b[0] <= R0[0][0]; mul_en[0] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[1] <= Rd[1][0]; mul_b[1] <= R0[1][0]; mul_en[1] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[2] <= Rd[2][0]; mul_b[2] <= R0[2][0]; mul_en[2] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[3] <= Rd[0][0]; mul_b[3] <= R0[0][1]; mul_en[3] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[4] <= Rd[1][0]; mul_b[4] <= R0[1][1]; mul_en[4] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[5] <= Rd[2][0]; mul_b[5] <= R0[2][1]; mul_en[5] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[6] <= Rd[0][0]; mul_b[6] <= R0[0][2]; mul_en[6] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[7] <= Rd[1][0]; mul_b[7] <= R0[1][2]; mul_en[7] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[8] <= Rd[2][0]; mul_b[8] <= R0[2][2]; mul_en[8] <= 1'b1;
                            fact_step <= 8'd1;
                        end
                        8'd1: begin
                            if (mul_vld[0]) begin
                                temp_reg[41] <= mul_z[0]; temp_reg[42] <= mul_z[1]; temp_reg[43] <= mul_z[2];
                                temp_reg[44] <= mul_z[3]; temp_reg[45] <= mul_z[4]; temp_reg[46] <= mul_z[5];
                                temp_reg[47] <= mul_z[6]; temp_reg[48] <= mul_z[7]; temp_reg[49] <= mul_z[8];
                                fact_step <= 8'd2;
                            end
                        end
                        8'd2: begin
                            add_a[0] <= temp_reg[41]; add_b[0] <= temp_reg[42]; add_en[0] <= 1'b1;
                            add_a[1] <= temp_reg[44]; add_b[1] <= temp_reg[45]; add_en[1] <= 1'b1;
                            add_a[2] <= temp_reg[47]; add_b[2] <= temp_reg[48]; add_en[2] <= 1'b1;
                            // M row1,2
                            mul_a[3] <= Rd[0][1]; mul_b[3] <= R0[0][0]; mul_en[3] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[4] <= Rd[1][1]; mul_b[4] <= R0[1][0]; mul_en[4] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[5] <= Rd[2][1]; mul_b[5] <= R0[2][0]; mul_en[5] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[6] <= Rd[0][1]; mul_b[6] <= R0[0][1]; mul_en[6] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[7] <= Rd[1][1]; mul_b[7] <= R0[1][1]; mul_en[7] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[8] <= Rd[2][1]; mul_b[8] <= R0[2][1]; mul_en[8] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[9] <= Rd[0][1]; mul_b[9] <= R0[0][2]; mul_en[9] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[10] <= Rd[1][1]; mul_b[10] <= R0[1][2]; mul_en[10] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[11] <= Rd[2][1]; mul_b[11] <= R0[2][2]; mul_en[11] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[12] <= Rd[0][2]; mul_b[12] <= R0[0][0]; mul_en[12] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[13] <= Rd[1][2]; mul_b[13] <= R0[1][0]; mul_en[13] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[14] <= Rd[2][2]; mul_b[14] <= R0[2][0]; mul_en[14] <= 1'b1;
                            mul_a[15] <= Rd[0][2]; mul_b[15] <= R0[0][1]; mul_en[15] <= 1'b1;
                            fact_step <= 8'd3;
                        end
                        8'd3: begin
                            if (add_vld[0] && mul_vld[3]) begin
                                temp_reg[50] <= add_z[0]; temp_reg[51] <= temp_reg[43];
                                temp_reg[52] <= add_z[1]; temp_reg[53] <= temp_reg[46];
                                temp_reg[54] <= add_z[2]; temp_reg[55] <= temp_reg[49];
                                temp_reg[56] <= mul_z[3]; temp_reg[57] <= mul_z[4]; temp_reg[58] <= mul_z[5];
                                temp_reg[59] <= mul_z[6]; temp_reg[60] <= mul_z[7]; temp_reg[61] <= mul_z[8];
                                temp_reg[62] <= mul_z[9]; temp_reg[63] <= mul_z[10]; temp_reg[64] <= mul_z[11];
                                temp_reg[65] <= mul_z[12]; temp_reg[66] <= mul_z[13]; temp_reg[67] <= mul_z[14];
                                temp_reg[68] <= mul_z[15];
                                fact_step <= 8'd4;
                            end
                        end
                        8'd4: begin
                            add_a[0] <= temp_reg[50]; add_b[0] <= temp_reg[51]; add_en[0] <= 1'b1; // M[0][0]
                            add_a[1] <= temp_reg[52]; add_b[1] <= temp_reg[53]; add_en[1] <= 1'b1; // M[0][1]
```

```systemverilog
// ============================================================================
// Axb Module: Unified Factor SIMD with Shared PE Pool
// Supports: Camera (projection), IMU (Pose3-Between), Prior (Pose3)
// Architecture: Single factor port + time-multiplexed PE pool + FSM microcode
// ============================================================================
module Axb #(
    parameter N = 24,        // Max columns (e.g., 3 poses*6 + 2 landmarks*3 = 24)
    parameter M = 48,        // Max rows (e.g., 10 camera*2 + 4 IMU*6 = 44)
    parameter NUM_MUL = 16,  // Shared multiplier pool
    parameter NUM_ADD = 12,  // Shared adder pool
    parameter NUM_SUB = 8    // Shared subtractor pool
)(
    input  wire                 clk,
    input  wire                 rst,

    // Problem size
    input  wire [7:0]           cfg_m,
    input  wire [7:0]           cfg_n,

    // ========================================================================
    // Unified Factor Input
    // ========================================================================
    input  wire                 factor_valid,
    output reg                  factor_ready,
    input  wire [1:0]           factor_type,    // 0=Camera, 1=IMU, 2=Prior
    input  wire [7:0]           factor_row_base,
    input  wire [2:0]           factor_rows,    // 2 or 6

    // Column indices for variable blocks
    input  wire [7:0]           col_var0,       // pose_i or landmark
    input  wire [7:0]           col_var1,       // pose_j or landmark

    // Row whitening (alpha_k = w_robust / sigma_k)
    input  wire [31:0]          alpha [0:5],

    // Camera payload
    input  wire [31:0]          cam_fx, cam_fy, cam_cx, cam_cy,
    input  wire [31:0]          cam_z_u, cam_z_v,
    input  wire [31:0]          cam_Pc_X, cam_Pc_Y, cam_Pc_Z, cam_Pc_invZ,
    input  wire [31:0]          cam_Rcw [0:2][0:2],

    // IMU/Prior payload
    input  wire [31:0]          R0 [0:2][0:2],  // Ri or Rp
    input  wire [31:0]          R1 [0:2][0:2],  // Rj (IMU)
    input  wire [31:0]          Rd [0:2][0:2],  // ΔR (IMU)
    input  wire [31:0]          t0 [0:2],       // ti or tp
    input  wire [31:0]          t1 [0:2],       // tj (IMU)
    input  wire [31:0]          td [0:2],       // Δt (IMU)

    // ========================================================================
    // Host load (testing/marginals)
    // ========================================================================
    input  wire                 load_valid,
    output wire                 load_ready,
    input  wire                 load_is_b,
    input  wire [7:0]           load_row,
    input  wire [7:0]           load_col,
    input  wire [31:0]          load_data,

    // ========================================================================
    // Row emission to QR
    // ========================================================================
    input  wire                 emit_start,
    output reg                  emit_done,
    output wire                 row_valid,
    input  wire                 row_ready,
    output wire [7:0]           row_idx,
    output wire [31:0]          row_A [0:N-1],
    output wire [31:0]          row_b
);

    // Buffers
    reg [31:0] matrix_buf [0:M-1][0:N-1];
    reg [31:0] b_buf      [0:M-1];

    // ========================================================================
    // Shared PE Pool
    // ========================================================================
    reg [31:0] mul_a [0:NUM_MUL-1], mul_b [0:NUM_MUL-1];
    reg        mul_en[0:NUM_MUL-1];
    wire[31:0] mul_z [0:NUM_MUL-1];
    wire       mul_vld[0:NUM_MUL-1];
    genvar gm;
    generate
        for (gm = 0; gm < NUM_MUL; gm = gm + 1) begin : MUL_PE
            PE_fp_mul u_mul (.clk(clk), .rstn(~rst), .in_vld(mul_en[gm]),
                .a(mul_a[gm]), .b(mul_b[gm]), .out_vld(mul_vld[gm]), .z(mul_z[gm]));
        end
    endgenerate

    reg [31:0] add_a [0:NUM_ADD-1], add_b [0:NUM_ADD-1];
    reg        add_en[0:NUM_ADD-1];
    wire[31:0] add_z [0:NUM_ADD-1];
    wire       add_vld[0:NUM_ADD-1];
    genvar ga;
    generate
        for (ga = 0; ga < NUM_ADD; ga = ga + 1) begin : ADD_PE
            PE_fp_add u_add (.clk(clk), .rstn(~rst), .in_vld(add_en[ga]),
                .a(add_a[ga]), .b(add_b[ga]), .out_vld(add_vld[ga]), .z(add_z[ga]));
        end
    endgenerate

    reg [31:0] sub_a [0:NUM_SUB-1], sub_b [0:NUM_SUB-1];
    reg        sub_en[0:NUM_SUB-1];
    wire[31:0] sub_z [0:NUM_SUB-1];
    wire       sub_vld[0:NUM_SUB-1];
    genvar gs;
    generate
        for (gs = 0; gs < NUM_SUB; gs = gs + 1) begin : SUB_PE
            PE_fp_sub u_sub (.clk(clk), .rstn(~rst), .in_vld(sub_en[gs]),
                .a(sub_a[gs]), .b(sub_b[gs]), .out_vld(sub_vld[gs]), .z(sub_z[gs]));
        end
    endgenerate

    reg [31:0] sqrt_in; reg sqrt_en; wire[31:0] sqrt_out; wire sqrt_vld;
    PE_fp_sqrt u_sqrt (.clk(clk), .rstn(~rst), .in_vld(sqrt_en),
        .a(sqrt_in), .out_vld(sqrt_vld), .z(sqrt_out));

    reg [31:0] div_num, div_den; reg div_en; wire[31:0] div_quot; wire div_vld;
    PE_fp_div u_div (.clk(clk), .rstn(~rst), .in_vld(div_en),
        .a(div_num), .b(div_den), .out_vld(div_vld), .z(div_quot));

    reg [31:0] atan_y, atan_x; reg atan_en; wire[31:0] atan_theta; wire atan_vld;
    Atan2Cordic u_atan (.clk(clk), .rstn(~rst), .in_vld(atan_en),
        .y(atan_y), .x(atan_x), .out_vld(atan_vld), .theta(atan_theta));

    reg [31:0] skew_x, skew_y, skew_z;
    wire[31:0] skew_K [0:2][0:2];
    Skew u_skew (.x(skew_x), .y(skew_y), .z(skew_z), .K(skew_K));

    // Constants
    localparam [31:0] FP_ZERO = 32'h00000000, FP_ONE = 32'h3f800000;
    localparam [31:0] FP_NEG_ONE = 32'hbf800000, FP_HALF = 32'h3f000000, FP_TWO = 32'h40000000;
    function automatic [31:0] negf(input [31:0] a); negf = {~a[31], a[30:0]}; endfunction

    // ========================================================================
    // FSM State Encoding
    // ========================================================================
    localparam [4:0] ST_IDLE=0, ST_CAM_P1=1, ST_CAM_P2=2, ST_CAM_P3=3, ST_CAM_P4=4,
                     ST_CAM_J1=5, ST_CAM_J2=6, ST_CAM_J3=7, ST_CAM_J4=8, ST_CAM_WR=9,
                     ST_IMU_V1=10, ST_IMU_V2=11, ST_IMU_RT1=12, ST_IMU_RT2=13,
                     ST_IMU_RR1=14, ST_IMU_RR2=15, ST_IMU_RR3=16, ST_IMU_J1=17, ST_IMU_WR=18,
                     ST_PRI_R1=19, ST_PRI_R2=20, ST_PRI_T1=21, ST_PRI_WR=22;
    reg [4:0] state;

    // Intermediate storage
    reg [31:0] tr [0:63];       // temp registers
    reg [31:0] jac [0:5][0:11]; // jacobian up to 6x12
    reg [31:0] res [0:5];       // residual up to 6

    integer i, j;

    // ========================================================================
    // Main FSM
    // ========================================================================
    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst) begin
            state <= ST_IDLE;
            factor_ready <= 1'b1;
            for (i=0; i<NUM_MUL; i=i+1) mul_en[i] <= 1'b0;
            for (i=0; i<NUM_ADD; i=i+1) add_en[i] <= 1'b0;
            for (i=0; i<NUM_SUB; i=i+1) sub_en[i] <= 1'b0;
            sqrt_en <= 1'b0; div_en <= 1'b0; atan_en <= 1'b0;
        end else begin
            // Default: clear all PE enables
            for (i=0; i<NUM_MUL; i=i+1) mul_en[i] <= 1'b0;
            for (i=0; i<NUM_ADD; i=i+1) add_en[i] <= 1'b0;
            for (i=0; i<NUM_SUB; i=i+1) sub_en[i] <= 1'b0;
            sqrt_en <= 1'b0; div_en <= 1'b0; atan_en <= 1'b0;

            case (state)
                ST_IDLE: begin
                    if (factor_valid && factor_ready) begin
                        factor_ready <= 1'b0;
                        case (factor_type)
                            2'd0: state <= ST_CAM_P1;
                            2'd1: state <= ST_IMU_V1;
                            2'd2: state <= ST_PRI_R1;
                            default: factor_ready <= 1'b1;
                        endcase
                    end
                end

                // ============================================================
                // CAMERA: Projection + Jacobian (2x9: 3 landmark + 6 pose)
                // ============================================================
                ST_CAM_P1: begin
                    // Compute projection intermediates
                    mul_a[0]<=cam_fx; mul_b[0]<=cam_Pc_invZ; mul_en[0]<=1'b1;
                    mul_a[1]<=cam_fy; mul_b[1]<=cam_Pc_invZ; mul_en[1]<=1'b1;
                    mul_a[2]<=cam_Pc_X; mul_b[2]<=cam_Pc_invZ; mul_en[2]<=1'b1;
                    mul_a[3]<=cam_Pc_Y; mul_b[3]<=cam_Pc_invZ; mul_en[3]<=1'b1;
                    mul_a[4]<=cam_Pc_invZ; mul_b[4]<=cam_Pc_invZ; mul_en[4]<=1'b1;
                    state <= ST_CAM_P2;
                end
                ST_CAM_P2: begin
                    if (mul_vld[0]) begin
                        tr[0]<=mul_z[0]; tr[1]<=mul_z[1]; tr[2]<=mul_z[2]; 
                        tr[3]<=mul_z[3]; tr[4]<=mul_z[4];
                        mul_a[0]<=cam_fx; mul_b[0]<=tr[2]; mul_en[0]<=1'b1;
                        mul_a[1]<=cam_fy; mul_b[1]<=tr[3]; mul_en[1]<=1'b1;
                        mul_a[2]<=cam_fx; mul_b[2]<=cam_Pc_X; mul_en[2]<=1'b1;
                        mul_a[3]<=cam_fy; mul_b[3]<=cam_Pc_Y; mul_en[3]<=1'b1;
                        state <= ST_CAM_P3;
                    end
                end
                ST_CAM_P3: begin
                    if (mul_vld[0]) begin
                        tr[5]<=mul_z[0]; tr[6]<=mul_z[1]; tr[7]<=mul_z[2]; tr[8]<=mul_z[3];
                        add_a[0]<=tr[5]; add_b[0]<=cam_cx; add_en[0]<=1'b1;
                        add_a[1]<=tr[6]; add_b[1]<=cam_cy; add_en[1]<=1'b1;
                        mul_a[0]<=tr[7]; mul_b[0]<=tr[4]; mul_en[0]<=1'b1;
                        mul_a[1]<=tr[8]; mul_b[1]<=tr[4]; mul_en[1]<=1'b1;
                        state <= ST_CAM_P4;
                    end
                end
                ST_CAM_P4: begin
                    if (add_vld[0] && mul_vld[0]) begin
                        tr[9]<=add_z[0]; tr[10]<=add_z[1]; tr[11]<=negf(mul_z[0]); tr[12]<=negf(mul_z[1]);
                        sub_a[0]<=cam_z_u; sub_b[0]<=tr[9]; sub_en[0]<=1'b1;
                        sub_a[1]<=cam_z_v; sub_b[1]<=tr[10]; sub_en[1]<=1'b1;
                        skew_x<=cam_Pc_X; skew_y<=cam_Pc_Y; skew_z<=cam_Pc_Z;
                        state <= ST_CAM_J1;
                    end
                end
                ST_CAM_J1: begin
                    if (sub_vld[0]) begin
                        res[0]<=sub_z[0]; res[1]<=sub_z[1];
                        // Jl row0 = [a11,0,a13]*R
                        mul_a[0]<=tr[0]; mul_b[0]<=cam_Rcw[0][0]; mul_en[0]<=1'b1;
                        mul_a[1]<=tr[0]; mul_b[1]<=cam_Rcw[0][1]; mul_en[1]<=1'b1;
                        mul_a[2]<=tr[0]; mul_b[2]<=cam_Rcw[0][2]; mul_en[2]<=1'b1;
                        mul_a[3]<=tr[11]; mul_b[3]<=cam_Rcw[2][0]; mul_en[3]<=1'b1;
                        mul_a[4]<=tr[11]; mul_b[4]<=cam_Rcw[2][1]; mul_en[4]<=1'b1;
                        mul_a[5]<=tr[11]; mul_b[5]<=cam_Rcw[2][2]; mul_en[5]<=1'b1;
                        state <= ST_CAM_J2;
                    end
                end
                ST_CAM_J2: begin
                    if (mul_vld[0]) begin
                        tr[20]<=mul_z[0]; tr[21]<=mul_z[1]; tr[22]<=mul_z[2];
                        tr[23]<=mul_z[3]; tr[24]<=mul_z[4]; tr[25]<=mul_z[5];
                        add_a[0]<=tr[20]; add_b[0]<=tr[23]; add_en[0]<=1'b1;
                        add_a[1]<=tr[21]; add_b[1]<=tr[24]; add_en[1]<=1'b1;
                        add_a[2]<=tr[22]; add_b[2]<=tr[25]; add_en[2]<=1'b1;
                        // Jl row1
                        mul_a[6]<=tr[1]; mul_b[6]<=cam_Rcw[1][0]; mul_en[6]<=1'b1;
                        mul_a[7]<=tr[1]; mul_b[7]<=cam_Rcw[1][1]; mul_en[7]<=1'b1;
                        mul_a[8]<=tr[1]; mul_b[8]<=cam_Rcw[1][2]; mul_en[8]<=1'b1;
                        mul_a[9]<=tr[12]; mul_b[9]<=cam_Rcw[2][0]; mul_en[9]<=1'b1;
                        mul_a[10]<=tr[12]; mul_b[10]<=cam_Rcw[2][1]; mul_en[10]<=1'b1;
                        mul_a[11]<=tr[12]; mul_b[11]<=cam_Rcw[2][2]; mul_en[11]<=1'b1;
                        state <= ST_CAM_J3;
                    end
                end
                ST_CAM_J3: begin
                    if (add_vld[0] && mul_vld[6]) begin
                        jac[0][0]<=add_z[0]; jac[0][1]<=add_z[1]; jac[0][2]<=add_z[2];
                        tr[26]<=mul_z[6]; tr[27]<=mul_z[7]; tr[28]<=mul_z[8];
                        tr[29]<=mul_z[9]; tr[30]<=mul_z[10]; tr[31]<=mul_z[11];
                        add_a[0]<=tr[26]; add_b[0]<=tr[29]; add_en[0]<=1'b1;
                        add_a[1]<=tr[27]; add_b[1]<=tr[30]; add_en[1]<=1'b1;
                        add_a[2]<=tr[28]; add_b[2]<=tr[31]; add_en[2]<=1'b1;
                        // Jpose trans: row0=[a11,0,a13], row1=[0,a22,a23]
                        jac[0][3]<=tr[0]; jac[0][4]<=FP_ZERO; jac[0][5]<=tr[11];
```
